"""Pinned, serial ORFS builds with retained artifacts and resource guards."""
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import time
from .contracts import IMAGE, ORFS_COMMIT, sha256, write_json


def available_memory():
    values = dict(line.split(':', 1) for line in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines())
    return int(values['MemAvailable'].split()[0])*1024


def prepare(root):
    root = Path(root).resolve(); root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    repo = root/'orfs'
    if not (repo/'.git').exists():
        subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--no-checkout',
                        'https://github.com/The-OpenROAD-Project/OpenROAD-flow-scripts.git', str(repo)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'sparse-checkout', 'set', 'flow/designs/asap7/gcd',
                    'flow/designs/asap7/uart', 'flow/designs/src/gcd', 'flow/designs/src/uart',
                    'flow/scripts', 'flow/util', 'flow/platforms/asap7', 'flow/platforms/common'], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'checkout', ORFS_COMMIT], check=True)
    pinned = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if pinned != ORFS_COMMIT:
        raise ValueError('ORFS revision mismatch')
    submodules = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'ls-tree', 'HEAD', 'tools/'], text=True)
    image = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'image', 'inspect', IMAGE], text=True))[0]
    probe = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'run', '--rm', '--network=none', '--entrypoint', 'bash', IMAGE,
        '-lc', 'source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh; openroad -version; yosys -V; klayout -v; sha256sum /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/bin/openroad /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/yosys/bin/yosys'], text=True)
    collateral = repo/'flow/platforms/asap7'
    hashes = {str(p.relative_to(collateral)): sha256(p) for p in sorted(collateral.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
    result = {'orfs_commit': pinned, 'image': IMAGE, 'image_id': image['Id'], 'submodules': submodules,
              'tool_versions': probe, 'collateral_sha256': hashes}
    write_json(root/'toolchain.json', result)
    return result


def build_source(root, design, group, factor=1., density=None, attempt=1):
    """Run one complete source build. Resume only a verified completed build."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    if design not in ('gcd', 'uart') or group not in (0, 1) or factor not in (1., .9, .8):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported source configuration')
    lock = root/'.build.lock'
    with lock.open('x'): pass
    try:
        density = density if density is not None else ((.35, .45) if design == 'gcd' else (.55, .65))[group]
        identity = f'{design}_g{group}' + (f'_stress_{factor:.2f}' if density == .75 else '')
        work = root/'builds'/(identity + (f'_attempt{attempt}' if attempt > 1 else '')); work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        receipt = work/'build.json'
        if receipt.exists():
            previous = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
            old_config = (work/'config.mk').read_text() if (work/'config.mk').exists() else ''
            width = re.search(r'VERILOG_TOP_PARAMS\s*=\s*DATA_WIDTH\s+(\d+)', old_config)
            utilization = re.search(r'CORE_UTILIZATION\s*=\s*(\d+)', old_config)
            if (previous.get('image') != IMAGE or previous.get('density') != density or
                    (design == 'uart' and (int(width.group(1)) if width else 8) != (12 if group else 8)) or
                    (design == 'gcd' and (int(utilization.group(1)) if utilization else 65) != (50 if group else 65))):
                raise ValueError('Source configuration changed; retain the old build and use a new --attempt')
            if previous['status'] == 'complete' and all(sha256(work/p) == digest for p, digest in previous['artifacts'].items()):
                return previous
            raise ValueError(f'Build already attempted: {identity}; inspect its retained log')
        memory = min(8*1024**3, available_memory()-1024**3)
        if memory < 1024**3:
            result = {'status': 'blocked', 'identity': identity, 'reason': 'Less than 2 GiB available RAM', 'artifacts': {}}
            write_json(receipt, result); return result
        repo = root/'orfs'
        config = work/'config.mk'
        upstream = f'/repo/flow/designs/asap7/{design}/config.mk'
        density = density if density is not None else ((.35, .45) if design == 'gcd' else (.55, .65))[group]
        lines = [f'include {upstream}', f'export PLACE_DENSITY = {density}',
                 f'export FLOW_VARIANT = c2c3_{identity}', 'export NUM_CORES = 2',
                 'export CORNER = TC', 'export ASAP7_USE_VT = RVT', 'export SYNTH_USE_SYN = 0']
        if design == 'gcd' and group == 1:
            lines += ['export CORE_UTILIZATION = 50']
        if design == 'uart' and group == 1:
            lines += ['export VERILOG_TOP_PARAMS = DATA_WIDTH 12']
        if design == 'uart':
            lower, upper = 1.08, 16.
            scaled = lower+(upper-lower)*factor
            lines += [f'export DIE_AREA = 0 0 {scaled+1.0:.6f} {scaled+1.0:.6f}',
                      f'export CORE_AREA = {lower} {lower} {scaled:.6f} {scaled:.6f}']
        config.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
        work_mount = '/work'
        command = ['docker', 'run', '--rm', '--network=none', '--cpus=2', f'--memory={memory}',
                   f'--memory-swap={memory}', '--user', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}',
                   '--mount', f'type=bind,src={repo},dst=/repo', '--mount', f'type=bind,src={work},dst={work_mount}',
                   '--entrypoint', 'bash', IMAGE, '-lc',
                   'source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh; cd /repo/flow; '
                   'make FLOW_HOME=/repo/flow DESIGN_CONFIG=/work/config.mk WORK_HOME=/work NUM_CORES=2 '
                   'OPENROAD_EXE=/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/bin/openroad '
                   'YOSYS_EXE=/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/yosys/bin/yosys all']
        result = {'status': 'running', 'identity': identity, 'design': design, 'group': group,
                  'factor': factor, 'density': density, 'image': IMAGE, 'orfs_commit': ORFS_COMMIT,
                  'source_parameters': {'data_width': (12 if group else 8) if design == 'uart' else None,
                                        'core_utilization': (50 if group else 65) if design == 'gcd' else None},
                  'config_sha256': sha256(config), 'memory_limit_bytes': memory, 'threads': 2, 'artifacts': {}}
        write_json(receipt, result)
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            with (work/'build.log').open('w') as log:
                run = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=3600)
            result['exit_code'] = run.returncode
            # GDS is mandatory. A successful global-route stage is insufficient.
            gds = sorted(work.glob('results/**/6_final.gds'))
            required = {suffix: sorted(work.glob(f'results/**/6_final.{suffix}')) for suffix in ('gds', 'def', 'odb', 'v', 'sdc')}
            result['status'] = 'complete' if run.returncode == 0 and all(required.values()) else 'failed'
            result['final'] = {suffix: str(paths[0].relative_to(work)) for suffix, paths in required.items() if paths}
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result.update(status='timeout', reason='Flow exceeded 60 minutes')
        except OSError as exc:
            result.update(status='blocked', reason=str(exc))
        result['wall_seconds'] = time.monotonic()-started
        result['artifacts'] = {str(p.relative_to(work)): sha256(p) for p in sorted(work.rglob('*'))
                               if p.is_file() and p != receipt}
        write_json(receipt, result)
        return result
    finally:
        lock.unlink()

"""One attempt per entry, with acceptance gates and durable checkpoints."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import time
from .manifest import BenchmarkManifestManager as Manifests
from .scorer import BenchmarkScorer
from .types import EvaluationResult, BenchmarkVerdict as V
from .acceptance import verify_case
from ..config import DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR
from ..profile import DRCProfileManager
from ..run_manifest import RunSpec
from ..single_shot import SingleShotOrchestrator
from ..marker_comparison import compare_markers
from ..parser import DRCParser


class BenchmarkEvaluator:
    def __init__(self, base_dir, output_dir=None, profile_name='asap7_curated', profile_manager=None, workers=4):
        self.workers = workers
        if not 1 <= workers <= 4:
            raise ValueError("Workers must be between 1 and 4")
        self.base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()
        self.profile_name = profile_name
        self.profile_manager = profile_manager or DRCProfileManager()
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f')
        self.output_dir = Path(output_dir) if output_dir else DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR / f'benchmark_{stamp}'
        self.runs_dir = self.output_dir/'runs'
        self.runs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def evaluate_case(self, case, mode='heuristic', candidate_script=None):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        profile = self.profile_manager.get_profile(self.profile_name)
        result = EvaluationResult(case.case_id, case.rule_id, case.tier, mode, None, None,
                                  None, None, V.ORACLE_MISMATCH, None, None, 0.,
                                  initially_clean=case.expected_initial_violations == 0,
                                  duplicate_group=case.acceptance.get('duplicate_group'))
        try:
            verify_case(case, self.base_dir, profile)
            spec = RunSpec(case_name=case.case_id, input_gds=self.base_dir/case.gds_rel_path,
                           drc_script=profile.deck_path, profile_name=self.profile_name,
                           candidate_mode=mode, candidate_script=candidate_script, output_root=self.runs_dir,
                           expected_counts=case.acceptance['observed_counts'],
                           expected_markers=case.acceptance['observed_markers'],
                           preservation=case.acceptance['preservation'])
            orchestrator = SingleShotOrchestrator(spec, self.profile_manager)
            result.run_dir = str(orchestrator.paths.run_dir)
            summary = orchestrator.run()
            result.actual_mode = spec.candidate_mode if summary.verdict not in ("blocked", "oracle_mismatch") else None
            result.pipeline_verdict = summary.verdict
            result.initial_violations = summary.violations_before
            result.final_violations = summary.violations_after
            result.initial_total, result.final_total = summary.total_before, summary.total_after
            result.validation = summary.validation_result.to_dict() if summary.validation_result else None
            result.validation_level = summary.validation_level
            result.error_message = summary.error_message
            if summary.diff_report:
                result.area_added_um2 = summary.diff_report.total_added_area_um2
                result.area_removed_um2 = summary.diff_report.total_removed_area_um2
            if summary.total_after is not None:
                result.marker_comparison = compare_markers(DRCParser().parse(orchestrator.paths.before_lyrdb),
                                                           DRCParser().parse(orchestrator.paths.after_lyrdb),
                                                           profile.manufacturing_grid_um)
            result.verdict = BenchmarkScorer.classify_verdict(
                result.initial_violations, result.final_violations, summary.error_message,
                pipeline_verdict=summary.verdict, validation=summary.validation_result,
                changed=bool(summary.diff_report and summary.diff_report.modified_layers),
                marker_comparison=result.marker_comparison)
            if result.verdict in (V.CLEAN_SUCCESS, V.CLEAN_UNCHANGED):
                result.failure_stage = None
            else:
                result.failure_stage = {
                    V.ORACLE_MISMATCH: 'baseline', V.BLOCKED: 'infrastructure', V.CHECKER_ERROR: 'checker',
                    V.MODEL_ERROR: 'synthesis', V.INVALID_PATCH: 'preservation' if summary.validation_result else 'python_execution',
                    V.EXECUTION_ERROR: 'python_execution', V.REGRESSION: 'regression',
                    V.FAILED_UNCHANGED: 'geometry_reasoning', V.PARTIAL_SUCCESS: 'geometry_reasoning',
                    V.UNNECESSARY_EDIT: 'unnecessary_edit', V.AMBIGUOUS: 'uncertain'}.get(result.verdict, 'uncertain')
        except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError) as exc:
            result.error_message = str(exc)
            result.failure_stage = 'infrastructure' if result.run_dir else 'baseline'
            result.verdict = V.EXECUTION_ERROR if result.run_dir else V.ORACLE_MISMATCH
        except Exception as exc:
            result.verdict = V.EXECUTION_ERROR
            result.failure_stage = 'infrastructure'
            result.error_message = str(exc)
        result.execution_time_s = time.perf_counter()-started
        if result.run_dir:
            directory = Path(result.run_dir)
            output = directory/'benchmark_result.json'
            output.write_text(json.dumps(result.to_dict(), indent=2))
            manifest_path = directory/'run_manifest.json'
            if manifest_path.exists():
                audit = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
                audit.setdefault('artifact_hashes', {})[output.name] = Manifests.compute_sha256(output)
                manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, indent=2))
        return result

    def evaluate_batch(self, cases, mode='heuristic', candidate_script=None, verbose=True):
        # Exclusive campaign lock prevents concurrent duplicate requests. Do not silently
        # remove a stale lock: an interrupted request needs manual status inspection.
        batch_start = time.perf_counter()
        lock = self.output_dir/'.campaign.lock'
        with lock.open('x'):
            pass
        try:
            manifest = Manifests.load(self.base_dir/'manifest.json')
            model_config = None
            if mode == 'agent':
                config_script = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]/'harness/scripts/model-config.mjs'
                model_config = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
                    ['node', str(config_script)], text=True, timeout=10))
            identity = {'schema_version': 2, 'benchmark_version': manifest.benchmark_version,
                        'manifest_sha256': Manifests.compute_sha256(self.base_dir/'manifest.json'),
                        'profile': self.profile_name, 'mode': mode, 'workers': self.workers, 'case_ids': [c.case_id for c in cases],
                        'model': model_config['model'] if model_config else None,
                        'temperature': model_config['temperature'] if model_config else None,
                        'model_config': model_config,
                        'script_sha256': Manifests.compute_sha256(candidate_script) if candidate_script else None,
                        'source_sha256': self._source_digest()}
            campaign = self.output_dir/'campaign.json'
            if campaign.exists():
                if json.loads(campaign.read_text()) != identity:
                    raise ValueError('Campaign configuration changed; use a new output directory')
            else:
                campaign.write_text(json.dumps(identity, indent=2))
                (self.output_dir/'frozen_source.json').write_text(json.dumps(self._source_bundle(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
            frozen = json.loads((self.output_dir/'frozen_source.json').read_text())
            if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(frozen, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() != identity['source_sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Frozen source bundle does not match campaign identity')
            from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
            collected = {}
            checkpoint = self.output_dir/'cases'; checkpoint.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            pending = []
            for case in cases:
                path = checkpoint/f'{case.case_id}.json'
                claim = checkpoint/f'{case.case_id}.attempt.json'
                if path.exists():
                    collected[case.case_id] = EvaluationResult.from_dict(json.loads(path.read_text()))
                elif claim.exists():
                    raise ValueError(f'Interrupted attempt for {case.case_id}; inspect artifacts. No automatic retry.')
                else:
                    pending.append(case)

            def execute(case):
                claim = checkpoint/f'{case.case_id}.attempt.json'
                with claim.open('x') as handle:
                    json.dump({'case_id': case.case_id, 'mode': mode,
                               'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}, handle)
                return self.evaluate_case(case, mode, candidate_script)

            def persist(case, result):
                path = checkpoint/f'{case.case_id}.json'
                temporary = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
                temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result.to_dict(), indent=2)); temporary.replace(path)
                collected[case.case_id] = result
                results = [collected[c.case_id] for c in cases if c.case_id in collected]
                self._export(BenchmarkScorer.aggregate(manifest.benchmark_version, mode, results,
                                                       sum(r.execution_time_s for r in results)))
                if verbose:
                    print(f'{case.case_id}: {result.verdict.value}', flush=True)

            # Validate infrastructure with the first requested model attempt before
            # dispatching the remaining independent requests. Never retry that attempt.
            if mode == 'agent' and pending and not collected:
                first = pending.pop(0)
                pilot = execute(first); persist(first, pilot)
                infra_failure = pilot.verdict in (V.BLOCKED, V.ORACLE_MISMATCH, V.CHECKER_ERROR) or (pilot.verdict == V.MODEL_ERROR and (not pilot.run_dir or not (Path(pilot.run_dir)/'model_response.json').exists()))
                if infra_failure:
                    for case in pending:
                        result = EvaluationResult(case.case_id, case.rule_id, case.tier, mode,
                            None, None, None, None, V.BLOCKED, None, None, 0.,
                            error_message='Campaign stopped after first-case preflight/synthesis failure; no model request was sent for this entry',
                            failure_stage='infrastructure', initially_clean=case.expected_initial_violations == 0,
                            duplicate_group=case.acceptance.get('duplicate_group'))
                        persist(case, result)
                    pending = []
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.workers) as pool:
                futures = {pool.submit(execute, case): case for case in pending}
                for future in as_completed(futures):
                    persist(futures[future], future.result())
            results = [collected[c.case_id] for c in cases]
            summary = BenchmarkScorer.aggregate(manifest.benchmark_version, mode, results,
                                                 sum(r.execution_time_s for r in results))
            self._export(summary)
            (self.output_dir/'timing.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch_wall_seconds': time.perf_counter()-batch_start, 'sum_case_seconds': summary.total_runtime_s}, indent=2))
            return summary
        finally:
            lock.unlink()

    @staticmethod
    def _source_bundle():
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
        bundle = {}
        for directory, patterns in [('src', ['*.py']), ('harness', ['*.ts', '*.js', '*.mjs', '*.md', '*.yaml', 'package.json']), ('knowledge', ['*.md'])]:
            for path in sorted({p for pattern in patterns for p in (root/directory).rglob(pattern)
                                if 'node_modules' not in p.parts}):
                bundle[str(path.relative_to(root))] = path.read_text()
        for name in ('pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock', 'harness/tsconfig.json'):
            bundle[name] = (root/name).read_text()
        return bundle

    @classmethod
    def _source_digest(cls):
        return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(cls._source_bundle(), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

    def _export(self, summary):
        BenchmarkScorer.export_json(summary, self.output_dir/'summary.json')
        BenchmarkScorer.export_csv(summary, self.output_dir/'summary.csv')
        (self.output_dir/'report.md').write_text(BenchmarkScorer.export_markdown(summary))
src/klayout_drc/benchmark/generator.py:
"""Deterministic layout generator for the 100-case ASAP7 BEOL benchmark suite.

Constructs 20 cases per rule family across 4 difficulty tiers:
  - 10 Isolated
  - 4 Boundary
  - 3 Interaction
  - 3 Negative
Total: 100 cases across M1.W.1, M2.W.1, M1.A.1, M1.S.1, V1.W.1.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import pya

from klayout_drc.benchmark.manifest import BenchmarkManifestManager
from klayout_drc.benchmark.mutations import (
    create_area_and_spacing_interaction,
    create_area_pad,
    create_cross_shaped_pad,
    create_jog_wire,
    create_l_bend_wire,
    create_l_shaped_pad,
    create_notched_wire,
    create_parallel_wires,
    create_stepped_wire,
    create_straight_wire,
    create_t_junction_wire,
    create_three_parallel_wires,
    create_u_channel,
    create_via_array,
    create_via_cut,
    create_via_and_wire_interaction,
    create_width_and_spacing_interaction,
    write_layout,
)
from klayout_drc.benchmark.types import (
    BenchmarkCaseSpec,
    BenchmarkManifest,
    DifficultyTier,
)
from klayout_drc.config import (
    ASAP7_DBU_UM,
    ASAP7_LAYER_M1,
    ASAP7_LAYER_M2,
    ASAP7_LAYER_V1,
)

BENCHMARK_VERSION: str = "1.1.0"
BENCHMARK_DESCRIPTION: str = "ASAP7 7nm Predictive BEOL DRC Benchmark Suite (100 synthetic & boundary mutation cases)"
RULE_FAMILIES: List[str] = ["M1.W.1", "M2.W.1", "M1.A.1", "M1.S.1", "V1.W.1"]


class BenchmarkGenerator:
    """Orchestrates deterministic layout creation and manifest generation for the 100 benchmark cases."""

    def __init__(self, dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM) -> None:
        if dbu_um != ASAP7_DBU_UM:
            raise ValueError("The frozen C1 catalog requires DBU 0.00025 um")
        self.dbu_um = dbu_um

    def generate_all(self, output_dir: Path) -> BenchmarkManifest:
        """Generate all 100 benchmark GDS files and save the manifest.json index.

        Args:
            output_dir: Root directory for the benchmark dataset (e.g. test_data/benchmark_v1).

        Returns:
            The complete, cryptographically verified BenchmarkManifest.
        """
        cases_dir = output_dir / "cases"
        cases_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        specs: List[BenchmarkCaseSpec] = []

        # 1. Generate 20 cases for M1.W.1
        specs.extend(self._generate_m1_w1_cases(cases_dir))

        # 2. Generate 20 cases for M2.W.1
        specs.extend(self._generate_m2_w1_cases(cases_dir))

        # 3. Generate 20 cases for M1.A.1
        specs.extend(self._generate_m1_a1_cases(cases_dir))

        # 4. Generate 20 cases for M1.S.1
        specs.extend(self._generate_m1_s1_cases(cases_dir))

        # 5. Generate 20 cases for V1.W.1
        specs.extend(self._generate_v1_w1_cases(cases_dir))

        assert len(specs) == 100, f"Expected exactly 100 cases, generated {len(specs)}"

        manifest = BenchmarkManifest(
            benchmark_version=BENCHMARK_VERSION,
            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            description=BENCHMARK_DESCRIPTION,
            rule_families=list(RULE_FAMILIES),
            cases=specs,
        )

        from .acceptance import accept_manifest
        manifest = accept_manifest(manifest, output_dir)
        manifest_path = output_dir / "manifest.json"
        BenchmarkManifestManager.save(manifest, manifest_path)
        return manifest

    def _write_and_build_spec(
        self,
        layout: pya.Layout,
        cases_dir: Path,
        case_id: str,
        rule_id: str,
        tier: DifficultyTier,
        expected_violations: int,
        expected_rules: List[str],
        description: str,
        tags: List[str],
    ) -> BenchmarkCaseSpec:
        """Write layout to disk and compute cryptographic SHA-256 hash."""
        gds_filename = f"{case_id}.gds"
        full_gds_path = cases_dir / gds_filename
        write_layout(layout, full_gds_path)

        sha256 = BenchmarkManifestManager.compute_sha256(full_gds_path)
        rel_path = f"cases/{gds_filename}"

        return BenchmarkCaseSpec(
            case_id=case_id,
            rule_id=rule_id,
            tier=tier,
            gds_rel_path=rel_path,
            sha256=sha256,
            expected_initial_violations=expected_violations,
            expected_rules=expected_rules,
            description=description,
            tags=tags,
        )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. M1.W.1 Case Definitions (20 cases)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _generate_m1_w1_cases(self, cases_dir: Path) -> List[BenchmarkCaseSpec]:
        specs: List[BenchmarkCaseSpec] = []
        rule = "M1.W.1"

        # Isolated (10 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.010, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_01", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M1 wire with width 10nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical", "gross_defect"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.012, 0.080, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_02", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M1 wire with width 12nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.014, 0.120, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_03", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M1 wire with width 14nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.015, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_04", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M1 wire with width 15nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.016, 0.060, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_05", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M1 wire with width 16nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical", "short_run"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.012, 0.100, False),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_06", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight horizontal M1 wire with width 12nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "horizontal"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_notched_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.024, 0.014, 0.120, 0.030, 0.040),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_07", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "M1 wire with narrow 14nm edge notch", ["width", "notch"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_stepped_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.024, 0.012, (0.030, 0.040, 0.030)),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_08", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "M1 wire with narrow 12nm bottleneck segment", ["width", "stepped", "bottleneck"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_l_bend_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.014, 0.060, 0.024, 0.060),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_09", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "L-bend M1 wire with narrow 14nm vertical leg", ["width", "l_bend"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_t_junction_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.024, 0.100, 0.012, 0.050, 0.030),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_iso_10", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "M1 T-junction with narrow 12nm branch", ["width", "t_junction"]
        ))

        # Boundary (4 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.01775, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_bnd_01", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 1, [rule],
            "M1 wire at width 17.75nm (-1 DBU grid step below limit)", ["width", "boundary", "1dbu"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.01750, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_bnd_02", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 1, [rule],
            "M1 wire at width 17.50nm (-2 DBU grid steps below limit)", ["width", "boundary", "2dbu"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.01775, 0.100, False),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_bnd_03", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 1, [rule],
            "Horizontal M1 wire at width 17.75nm (-1 DBU grid step)", ["width", "boundary", "horizontal"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.018, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_bnd_04", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 0, [],
            "M1 wire exactly at specification threshold 18nm (legal boundary)", ["width", "boundary", "exact_threshold"]
        ))

        # Interaction (3 cases)
        # Compound: Spaced pair (40nm wires, 14nm space) + narrow wire (14nm width)
        l_w_s = pya.Layout()
        l_w_s.dbu = self.dbu_um
        top_ws = l_w_s.create_cell("TOP")
        l_m1_ws = l_w_s.layer(ASAP7_LAYER_M1[0], ASAP7_LAYER_M1[1])
        top_ws.shapes(l_m1_ws).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, 160, 400))       # Track 1: 40nm x 100nm
        top_ws.shapes(l_m1_ws).insert(pya.Box(216, 0, 376, 400))     # Track 2: 40nm x 100nm (spacing 14nm = 56 DBU)
        top_ws.shapes(l_m1_ws).insert(pya.Box(500, 0, 556, 400))     # Track 3: 14nm width (56 DBU) -> M1.W.1
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            l_w_s,
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_int_01", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, ["M1.W.1", "M1.S.1"],
            "Compound layout with M1.S.1 spacing pair (14nm space) and M1.W.1 narrow wire (14nm)", ["compound", "width", "spacing"]
        ))
        # Narrow M1 wire (14nm width) with rectangular V1 via cut (18nm x 12nm, height 12nm -> 1 V1.W.1 violation)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_and_wire_interaction(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.018, 0.012, 0.014, 0.100),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_int_02", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, ["M1.W.1", "V1.W.1"],
            "M1 narrow wire (14nm) coupled with rectangular V1 via (18nm x 12nm)", ["compound", "width", "via"]
        ))
        # Two narrow bottlenecks along one wire
        l_stepped_dual = pya.Layout()
        l_stepped_dual.dbu = self.dbu_um
        top = l_stepped_dual.create_cell("TOP")
        l_idx = l_stepped_dual.layer(ASAP7_LAYER_M1[0], ASAP7_LAYER_M1[1])
        top.shapes(l_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, 48, 120))          # 12nm bottleneck 1 (48 DBU)
        top.shapes(l_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 120, 96, 240))        # 24nm wide
        top.shapes(l_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 240, 56, 360))        # 14nm bottleneck 2 (56 DBU)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            l_stepped_dual,
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_int_03", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, [rule],
            "Stepped M1 wire with dual independent width bottlenecks (12nm and 14nm)", ["compound", "width", "dual_violation"]
        ))

        # Negative Clean (3 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.018, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_01", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal straight M1 wire (18nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "legal_wire"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.028, 0.120, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_02", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean wide M1 wire (28nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "wide_wire"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_l_bend_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.020, 0.060, 0.020, 0.060),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_03", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal L-bend M1 wire (20nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "l_bend"]
        ))

        return specs

        # Negative Clean (3 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.018, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_01", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal straight M1 wire (18nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "legal_wire"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.028, 0.120, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_02", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean wide M1 wire (28nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "wide_wire"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_l_bend_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.020, 0.060, 0.020, 0.060),
            cases_dir, "m1_w1_neg_03", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal L-bend M1 wire (20nm width)", ["negative", "clean", "l_bend"]
        ))

        return specs

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. M2.W.1 Case Definitions (20 cases)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _generate_m2_w1_cases(self, cases_dir: Path) -> List[BenchmarkCaseSpec]:
        specs: List[BenchmarkCaseSpec] = []
        rule = "M2.W.1"

        # Isolated (10 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M2, 0.010, 0.100, True),
            cases_dir, "m2_w1_iso_01", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M2 wire with width 10nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical", "m2"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M2, 0.012, 0.080, True),
            cases_dir, "m2_w1_iso_02", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Straight vertical M2 wire with width 12nm (< 18nm)", ["width", "vertical", "m2"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_straight_wire(ASAP7_LAYER_M2, 0.014, 0.120, True),
            cases_dir, "m2_w1_iso_03", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],

            create_parallel_wires(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.040, 0.100, 0.018, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_s1_neg_01", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean parallel M1 wires with legal 18nm spacing", ["negative", "clean", "legal_spacing"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_parallel_wires(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.040, 0.100, 0.024, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_s1_neg_02", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean parallel M1 wires with wide 24nm spacing", ["negative", "clean", "wide_spacing"]
        ))
        # Short parallel shapes (edge length 30nm <= 36nm) exempt by upstream rule
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_parallel_wires(ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.040, 0.030, 0.012, True),
            cases_dir, "m1_s1_neg_03", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Short parallel stubs (30nm length <= 36nm filter) with 12nm spacing (rule-exempt clean)",
            ["negative", "clean", "filter_exempt"]
        ))

        return specs

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. V1.W.1 Case Definitions (20 cases)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _generate_v1_w1_cases(self, cases_dir: Path) -> List[BenchmarkCaseSpec]:
        specs: List[BenchmarkCaseSpec] = []
        rule = "V1.W.1"

        # Isolated (10 cases) - undersized via cuts (< 18nm)
        # Note: In KLayout DRC, square cuts violate in both X and Y directions (2 edge-pair markers),
        # while rectangular cuts with one legal dimension violate in only 1 direction (1 edge-pair marker).
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.010, 0.010),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_01", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 2, [rule],

        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.012, 0.012),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_02", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut 12nm x 12nm (< 18nm, violates both dimensions)", ["via", "square"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.014, 0.014),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_03", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut 14nm x 14nm (< 18nm, violates both dimensions)", ["via", "square"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.015, 0.015),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_04", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut 15nm x 15nm (< 18nm, violates both dimensions)", ["via", "square"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.016, 0.016),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_05", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut 16nm x 16nm (< 18nm, violates both dimensions)", ["via", "square"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.012),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_06", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut 18nm x 12nm (height < 18nm)", ["via", "rectangular"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.014),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_07", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut 18nm x 14nm (height < 18nm)", ["via", "rectangular"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.012, 0.018),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_08", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut 12nm x 18nm (width < 18nm)", ["via", "rectangular"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.014, 0.020),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_09", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut 14nm x 20nm (width < 18nm)", ["via", "rectangular"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.016, 0.018),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_iso_10", rule, DifficultyTier.ISOLATED, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut 16nm x 18nm (width < 18nm)", ["via", "rectangular"]
        ))

        # Boundary (4 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.01775, 0.01775),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_bnd_01", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut at 17.75nm x 17.75nm (-1 DBU grid step below limit)", ["via", "boundary", "1dbu"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.01750, 0.01750),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_bnd_02", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 2, [rule],
            "Square V1 cut at 17.50nm x 17.50nm (-2 DBU grid steps below limit)", ["via", "boundary", "2dbu"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.01800, 0.01775),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_bnd_03", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 1, [rule],
            "Rectangular V1 cut at 18.0nm x 17.75nm (height -1 DBU)", ["via", "boundary", "rectangular"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.018),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_bnd_04", rule, DifficultyTier.BOUNDARY, 0, [],
            "Square V1 cut at exact threshold 18.0nm x 18.0nm (legal boundary)", ["via", "boundary", "exact_threshold"]
        ))

        # Interaction (3 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_and_wire_interaction(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, ASAP7_LAYER_M1, 0.018, 0.012, 0.014, 0.100),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_int_01", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, ["V1.W.1", "M1.W.1"],
            "Rectangular V1 cut (18nm x 12nm) landing on narrow M1 wire (14nm)", ["compound", "via", "m1"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_and_wire_interaction(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, ASAP7_LAYER_M2, 0.018, 0.012, 0.014, 0.100),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_int_02", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, ["V1.W.1", "M2.W.1"],
            "Rectangular V1 cut (18nm x 12nm) landing on narrow M2 wire (14nm)", ["compound", "via", "m2"]
        ))
        # Dual rectangular via cuts
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_array(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.012, 0.040, 2),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_int_03", rule, DifficultyTier.INTERACTION, 2, [rule],
            "Dual rectangular V1 cuts (18nm x 12nm each)", ["compound", "via", "dual_via"]
        ))

        # Negative Clean (3 cases)
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_cut(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.018),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_neg_01", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal single V1 cut (18nm x 18nm)", ["negative", "clean", "legal_via"]
        ))
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            create_via_array(ASAP7_LAYER_V1, 0.018, 0.018, 0.040, 2),
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_neg_02", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal dual V1 via array (18nm x 18nm cuts)", ["negative", "clean", "via_array"]
        ))
        # Legal via on legal M1 landing pad
        l_v1_pad = pya.Layout()
        l_v1_pad.dbu = self.dbu_um
        top_vp = l_v1_pad.create_cell("TOP")
        l_m1_vp = l_v1_pad.layer(ASAP7_LAYER_M1[0], ASAP7_LAYER_M1[1])
        l_v1_vp = l_v1_pad.layer(ASAP7_LAYER_V1[0], ASAP7_LAYER_V1[1])
        top_vp.shapes(l_m1_vp).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, 144, 144))  # 36nm x 36nm M1 pad
        top_vp.shapes(l_v1_vp).insert(pya.Box(36, 36, 108, 108)) # 18nm x 18nm V1 cut centered
        specs.append(self._write_and_build_spec(
            l_v1_pad,
            cases_dir, "v1_w1_neg_03", rule, DifficultyTier.NEGATIVE, 0, [],
            "Clean legal V1 via (18nm x 18nm) centered on legal M1 landing pad (36nm x 36nm)", ["negative", "clean", "enclosed_via"]
        ))

        return specs

"""Benchmark manifest manager for reading, writing, filtering, and verifying test cases.

Provides cryptographic integrity checks, metadata indexing, and query filtering
for the ASAP7 synthetic benchmark suite.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from klayout_drc.benchmark.types import (
    BenchmarkCaseSpec,
    BenchmarkManifest,
    DifficultyTier,
)
from klayout_drc.config import DRCConfigurationError


class BenchmarkManifestManager:
    """Manages serialization, filtering, and integrity verification of the benchmark manifest."""

    @staticmethod
    def compute_sha256(file_path: Path) -> str:
        """Compute the hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of a file."""
        if not file_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Target file for SHA-256 hashing does not exist: {file_path}")
        hasher = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            while chunk := f.read(65536):
                hasher.update(chunk)
        return hasher.hexdigest()

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, manifest_path: Path) -> BenchmarkManifest:
        """Load and parse a benchmark manifest from a JSON file.

        Args:
            manifest_path: Path to the manifest.json file.

        Returns:
            Strongly typed BenchmarkManifest.

        Raises:
            DRCConfigurationError: If the manifest does not exist or JSON parsing fails.
        """
        if not manifest_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Benchmark manifest not found at: {manifest_path}")

        try:
            with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                raw_data = json.load(f)
            return BenchmarkManifest.from_dict(raw_data)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Failed to parse benchmark manifest JSON from {manifest_path}: {exc}") from exc
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Missing required field in benchmark manifest {manifest_path}: {exc}") from exc

    @classmethod
    def save(cls, manifest: BenchmarkManifest, manifest_path: Path) -> None:
        """Save a benchmark manifest to a JSON file with deterministic formatting.

        Args:
            manifest: The BenchmarkManifest instance to save.
            manifest_path: Destination path.
        """
        manifest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(manifest.to_dict(), f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

    @classmethod
    def filter_cases(
        cls,
        manifest: BenchmarkManifest,
        rules: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        tiers: Optional[List[DifficultyTier]] = None,
        limit: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> List[BenchmarkCaseSpec]:
        """Filter benchmark cases based on rule families, difficulty tiers, and count limit.

        Args:
            manifest: Loaded benchmark manifest.
            rules: Optional list of rule IDs to include (e.g. ['M1.W.1', 'V1.W.1']).
            tiers: Optional list of difficulty tiers to include.
            limit: Optional maximum number of cases to return.

        Returns:
            Filtered list of BenchmarkCaseSpec.
        """
        filtered = manifest.cases

        if rules is not None and len(rules) > 0:
            rule_set = {r.strip() for r in rules}
            filtered = [c for c in filtered if c.rule_id in rule_set]

        if tiers is not None and len(tiers) > 0:
            tier_set = set(tiers)
            filtered = [c for c in filtered if c.tier in tier_set]

        if limit is not None and limit < 0:
            raise DRCConfigurationError("Limit must be nonnegative")
        if limit is not None:
            filtered = filtered[:limit]

        return filtered

    @classmethod
    def verify_integrity(
        cls,
        manifest: BenchmarkManifest,
        base_dir: Path,
    ) -> Dict[str, bool]:
        """Verify the presence and cryptographic SHA-256 hash of each case GDS file.

        Args:
            manifest: Loaded benchmark manifest.
            base_dir: Base directory against which relative GDS paths are resolved.

        Returns:
            Mapping of case_id -> boolean indicating whether the file matches expected hash.
        """
        verification_results: Dict[str, bool] = {}

        for case in manifest.cases:
            gds_path = base_dir / case.gds_rel_path
            if not gds_path.exists():
                verification_results[case.case_id] = False
                continue

            current_hash = cls.compute_sha256(gds_path)
            verification_results[case.case_id] = (current_hash == case.sha256)

        return verification_results
src/klayout_drc/benchmark/mutations.py:
"""Geometric mutation operators and layout construction primitives.

Constructs synthetic layout structures with precise dimensional control at the
0.25 nm database unit (DBU) grid for all 5 BEOL rule families:
  - M1.W.1 (M1 Width, 18 nm threshold)
  - M2.W.1 (M2 Width, 18 nm threshold)
  - M1.A.1 (M1 Area, 504 nm2 threshold)
  - M1.S.1 (M1 Spacing, 18 nm threshold for edges > 36 nm)
  - V1.W.1 (V1 Via Cut Width, 18 nm threshold)
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple
import pya

from klayout_drc.config import (
    ASAP7_DBU_UM,
    ASAP7_LAYER_M1,
    ASAP7_LAYER_M2,
    ASAP7_LAYER_V1,
)

TOP_CELL_NAME: str = "TOP"


def init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM) -> Tuple[pya.Layout, pya.Cell]:
    """Initialize an empty layout with TOP cell and standard ASAP7 DBU."""
    layout = pya.Layout()
    layout.dbu = dbu_um
    top_cell = layout.create_cell(TOP_CELL_NAME)
    return layout, top_cell


def write_layout(layout: pya.Layout, output_path: Path) -> None:
    """Save layout deterministically to disk."""
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    opt = pya.SaveLayoutOptions()
    opt.gds2_write_timestamps = False
    layout.write(str(output_path), opt)


def to_dbu(val_um: float, dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM) -> int:
    """Convert micrometer coordinate to integer database units."""
    return int(round(val_um / dbu_um))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wire & Width Primitives (M1.W.1 / M2.W.1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_straight_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    length_um: float,
    vertical: bool = True,
    x_offset_um: float = 0.0,
    y_offset_um: float = 0.0,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a single straight rectangular wire."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    x0 = to_dbu(x_offset_um, dbu_um)
    y0 = to_dbu(y_offset_um, dbu_um)

    if vertical:
        w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
        l = to_dbu(length_um, dbu_um)
        box = pya.Box(x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + l)
    else:
        w = to_dbu(length_um, dbu_um)
        l = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
        box = pya.Box(x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + l)

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(box)
    return layout


def create_notched_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    base_width_um: float,
    notch_width_um: float,
    total_length_um: float,
    notch_length_um: float,
    notch_start_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a vertical wire containing a narrow notch along one edge."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_base = to_dbu(base_width_um, dbu_um)
    w_notch = to_dbu(notch_width_um, dbu_um)
    l_total = to_dbu(total_length_um, dbu_um)
    l_notch = to_dbu(notch_length_um, dbu_um)
    y_start = to_dbu(notch_start_um, dbu_um)

    # Base full wire
    r_base = pya.Region(pya.Box(0, 0, w_base, l_total))
    # Cutout notch
    r_cutout = pya.Region(pya.Box(w_notch, y_start, w_base, y_start + l_notch))
    r_result = r_base - r_cutout

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r_result)
    return layout


def create_stepped_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    wide_width_um: float,
    narrow_width_um: float,
    segment_lengths_um: Tuple[float, float, float],
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a 3-segment stepped wire (wide -> narrow bottleneck -> wide)."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_wide = to_dbu(wide_width_um, dbu_um)
    w_narrow = to_dbu(narrow_width_um, dbu_um)
    l1 = to_dbu(segment_lengths_um[0], dbu_um)
    l2 = to_dbu(segment_lengths_um[1], dbu_um)
    l3 = to_dbu(segment_lengths_um[2], dbu_um)

    # Segment 1 (wide)
    box1 = pya.Box(0, 0, w_wide, l1)
    # Segment 2 (narrow bottleneck, centered or aligned)
    dx = (w_wide - w_narrow) // 2
    box2 = pya.Box(dx, l1, dx + w_narrow, l1 + l2)
    # Segment 3 (wide)
    box3 = pya.Box(0, l1 + l2, w_wide, l1 + l2 + l3)

    r = pya.Region(box1) + pya.Region(box2) + pya.Region(box3)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


def create_l_bend_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    leg1_w_um: float,
    leg1_l_um: float,
    leg2_w_um: float,
    leg2_l_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create an L-shaped bent wire with independent leg dimensions."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w1 = to_dbu(leg1_w_um, dbu_um)
    l1 = to_dbu(leg1_l_um, dbu_um)
    w2 = to_dbu(leg2_w_um, dbu_um)
    l2 = to_dbu(leg2_l_um, dbu_um)

    # Vertical leg
    box1 = pya.Box(0, 0, w1, l1)
    # Horizontal leg extending to the right from top of leg 1
    box2 = pya.Box(0, l1 - w2, l2, l1)

    r = pya.Region(box1) + pya.Region(box2)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


def create_t_junction_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    trunk_w_um: float,
    trunk_l_um: float,
    branch_w_um: float,
    branch_l_um: float,
    branch_y_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a T-junction with a main trunk and a perpendicular branch."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_trunk = to_dbu(trunk_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_trunk = to_dbu(trunk_l_um, dbu_um)
    w_branch = to_dbu(branch_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_branch = to_dbu(branch_l_um, dbu_um)
    y_branch = to_dbu(branch_y_um, dbu_um)

    box_trunk = pya.Box(0, 0, w_trunk, l_trunk)
    box_branch = pya.Box(w_trunk, y_branch, w_trunk + l_branch, y_branch + w_branch)

    r = pya.Region(box_trunk) + pya.Region(box_branch)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


def create_jog_wire(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    wire_w_um: float,
    jog_neck_w_um: float,
    seg_l_um: float,
    jog_offset_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a dogleg jog with a narrow diagonal or offset bridge."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(wire_w_um, dbu_um)
    w_jog = to_dbu(jog_neck_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_seg = to_dbu(seg_l_um, dbu_um)
    dx = to_dbu(jog_offset_um, dbu_um)

    # Lower vertical wire
    box1 = pya.Box(0, 0, w, l_seg)
    # Horizontal jog neck
    box_jog = pya.Box(0, l_seg - w_jog, dx + w, l_seg)
    # Upper vertical wire offset by dx
    box2 = pya.Box(dx, l_seg, dx + w, 2 * l_seg)

    r = pya.Region(box1) + pya.Region(box_jog) + pya.Region(box2)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Area Primitives (M1.A.1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_area_pad(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    length_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create an isolated rectangular landing pad with precise area."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
    l = to_dbu(length_um, dbu_um)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, w, l))
    return layout


def create_l_shaped_pad(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    w1_um: float,
    l1_um: float,
    w2_um: float,
    l2_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create an L-shaped small pad with exact total area."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w1 = to_dbu(w1_um, dbu_um)
    l1 = to_dbu(l1_um, dbu_um)
    w2 = to_dbu(w2_um, dbu_um)
    l2 = to_dbu(l2_um, dbu_um)

    b1 = pya.Box(0, 0, w1, l1)
    b2 = pya.Box(0, l1 - w2, l2, l1)
    r = pya.Region(b1) + pya.Region(b2)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


def create_cross_shaped_pad(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    core_w_um: float,
    core_l_um: float,
    arm_w_um: float,
    arm_l_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a cross-shaped micro pad."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_core = to_dbu(core_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_core = to_dbu(core_l_um, dbu_um)
    w_arm = to_dbu(arm_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_arm = to_dbu(arm_l_um, dbu_um)

    # Vertical bar
    b_vert = pya.Box(0, 0, w_core, l_core)
    # Horizontal arms
    y_mid = (l_core - w_arm) // 2
    b_horiz = pya.Box(-l_arm, y_mid, w_core + l_arm, y_mid + w_arm)

    r = pya.Region(b_vert) + pya.Region(b_horiz)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r)
    return layout


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spacing Primitives (M1.S.1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_parallel_wires(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    length_um: float,
    spacing_um: float,
    vertical: bool = True,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create two parallel wires separated by spacing_um.

    Note: Wires must have width and length > 36 nm to ensure edges are not
    filtered by upstream M1.S.1 rule:
      m1.space(18.nm).polygons.not_interacting(m1.edges.with_length(0..36.nm))
    """
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
    l = to_dbu(length_um, dbu_um)
    s = to_dbu(spacing_um, dbu_um)

    if vertical:
        b1 = pya.Box(0, 0, w, l)
        b2 = pya.Box(w + s, 0, 2 * w + s, l)
    else:
        b1 = pya.Box(0, 0, l, w)
        b2 = pya.Box(0, w + s, l, 2 * w + s)

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(b1)
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(b2)
    return layout


def create_three_parallel_wires(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    length_um: float,
    spacing1_um: float,
    spacing2_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create three parallel vertical wires separated by independent spacings."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
    l = to_dbu(length_um, dbu_um)
    s1 = to_dbu(spacing1_um, dbu_um)
    s2 = to_dbu(spacing2_um, dbu_um)

    x1 = 0
    x2 = w + s1
    x3 = x2 + w + s2

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(x1, 0, x1 + w, l))
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(x2, 0, x2 + w, l))
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(x3, 0, x3 + w, l))
    return layout


def create_u_channel(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    wall_w_um: float,
    channel_w_um: float,
    channel_depth_um: float,
    base_h_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a U-shaped channel testing inner cavity spacing."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_wall = to_dbu(wall_w_um, dbu_um)
    w_chan = to_dbu(channel_w_um, dbu_um)
    d_chan = to_dbu(channel_depth_um, dbu_um)
    h_base = to_dbu(base_h_um, dbu_um)

    # Base horizontal bar
    total_w = 2 * w_wall + w_chan
    total_h = h_base + d_chan

    r_outer = pya.Region(pya.Box(0, 0, total_w, total_h))
    r_cavity = pya.Region(pya.Box(w_wall, h_base, w_wall + w_chan, total_h))
    r_result = r_outer - r_cavity

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(r_result)
    return layout


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Via Primitives (V1.W.1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_via_cut(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    height_um: float,
    x_offset_um: float = 0.0,
    y_offset_um: float = 0.0,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create a single isolated via cut on V1."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
    h = to_dbu(height_um, dbu_um)
    x0 = to_dbu(x_offset_um, dbu_um)
    y0 = to_dbu(y_offset_um, dbu_um)

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + h))
    return layout


def create_via_array(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    width_um: float,
    height_um: float,
    pitch_x_um: float,
    count: int = 2,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Create an array of multiple via cuts along X."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w = to_dbu(width_um, dbu_um)
    h = to_dbu(height_um, dbu_um)
    pitch = to_dbu(pitch_x_um, dbu_um)

    for i in range(count):
        x0 = i * pitch
        top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(x0, 0, x0 + w, h))

    return layout


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compound Interaction Primitives
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_width_and_spacing_interaction(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    narrow_w_um: float,
    narrow_l_um: float,
    neighbor_w_um: float,
    neighbor_l_um: float,
    spacing_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Simultaneously triggers width violation on wire 1 and spacing violation to wire 2."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w1 = to_dbu(narrow_w_um, dbu_um)
    l1 = to_dbu(narrow_l_um, dbu_um)
    w2 = to_dbu(neighbor_w_um, dbu_um)
    l2 = to_dbu(neighbor_l_um, dbu_um)
    s = to_dbu(spacing_um, dbu_um)

    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, w1, l1))
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(w1 + s, 0, w1 + s + w2, l2))
    return layout


def create_area_and_spacing_interaction(
    layer_info: Tuple[int, int],
    pad_w_um: float,
    pad_l_um: float,
    trunk_w_um: float,
    trunk_l_um: float,
    spacing_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Simultaneously triggers M1.A.1 on small pad and M1.S.1 spacing to adjacent trunk."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info[0], layer_info[1])

    w_pad = to_dbu(pad_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_pad = to_dbu(pad_l_um, dbu_um)
    w_trunk = to_dbu(trunk_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_trunk = to_dbu(trunk_l_um, dbu_um)
    s = to_dbu(spacing_um, dbu_um)

    # Pad on left
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, w_pad, l_pad))
    # Trunk on right
    top.shapes(layer_idx).insert(pya.Box(w_pad + s, 0, w_pad + s + w_trunk, l_trunk))
    return layout


def create_via_and_wire_interaction(
    via_layer: Tuple[int, int],
    wire_layer: Tuple[int, int],
    via_w_um: float,
    via_h_um: float,
    wire_w_um: float,
    wire_l_um: float,
    dbu_um: float = ASAP7_DBU_UM,
) -> pya.Layout:
    """Triggers both via cut width violation and underlying wire width violation."""
    layout, top = init_benchmark_layout(dbu_um)
    l_via = layout.layer(via_layer[0], via_layer[1])
    l_wire = layout.layer(wire_layer[0], wire_layer[1])

    w_wire = to_dbu(wire_w_um, dbu_um)
    l_wire_len = to_dbu(wire_l_um, dbu_um)
    w_via = to_dbu(via_w_um, dbu_um)
    h_via = to_dbu(via_h_um, dbu_um)

    top.shapes(l_wire).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, w_wire, l_wire_len))
    top.shapes(l_via).insert(pya.Box(0, 0, w_via, h_via))
    return layout

"""Versioned benchmark contracts. Missing observations remain null."""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
import re
from typing import Any


class DifficultyTier(str, Enum):
    ISOLATED = "isolated"
    BOUNDARY = "boundary"
    INTERACTION = "interaction"
    NEGATIVE = "negative"


class BenchmarkVerdict(str, Enum):
    CLEAN_SUCCESS = "clean_success"
    PARTIAL_SUCCESS = "partial_success"
    REGRESSION = "regression"
    FAILED_UNCHANGED = "failed_unchanged"
    EXECUTION_ERROR = "execution_error"
    INVALID_PATCH = "invalid_patch"
    MODEL_ERROR = "model_error"
    CHECKER_ERROR = "checker_error"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    ORACLE_MISMATCH = "oracle_mismatch"
    CLEAN_UNCHANGED = "clean_unchanged"
    UNNECESSARY_EDIT = "unnecessary_edit"
    AMBIGUOUS = "ambiguous"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BenchmarkCaseSpec:
    case_id: str
    rule_id: str
    tier: DifficultyTier
    gds_rel_path: str
    sha256: str
    expected_initial_violations: int
    expected_rules: list[str]
    description: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    acceptance: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self):
        data = asdict(self)
        data["tier"] = self.tier.value
        return data

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data):
        return cls(**{**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__},
                      "tier": DifficultyTier(data["tier"])})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BenchmarkManifest:
    benchmark_version: str
    created_at: str
    description: str
    rule_families: list[str]
    cases: list[BenchmarkCaseSpec]
    acceptance: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def case_count(self):
        return len(self.cases)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {"benchmark_version": self.benchmark_version, "created_at": self.created_at,
                "description": self.description, "rule_families": self.rule_families,
                "case_count": self.case_count, "cases": [c.to_dict() for c in self.cases],
                "acceptance": self.acceptance}

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data):
        cases = [BenchmarkCaseSpec.from_dict(c) for c in data["cases"]]
        ids = [c.case_id for c in cases]
        if any(not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", case_id) for case_id in ids):
            raise ValueError("Invalid case ID")
        if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate case IDs")
        return cls(data["benchmark_version"], data["created_at"], data["description"],
                   data["rule_families"], cases, data.get("acceptance", {}))


@dataclass
class EvaluationResult:
    case_id: str
    rule_id: str
    tier: DifficultyTier
    mode: str
    initial_violations: dict[str, int] | None
    final_violations: dict[str, int] | None
    initial_total: int | None
    final_total: int | None
    verdict: BenchmarkVerdict
    area_added_um2: float | None
    area_removed_um2: float | None
    execution_time_s: float
    error_message: str | None = None
    run_dir: str | None = None
    schema_version: int = 2
    actual_mode: str | None = None
    pipeline_verdict: str | None = None
    failure_stage: str | None = None
    validation: dict | None = None
    marker_comparison: dict | None = None
    initially_clean: bool = False
    duplicate_group: str | None = None
    validation_level: str = "not_run"

    def to_dict(self):
        data = asdict(self)
        data.update(tier=self.tier.value, verdict=self.verdict.value)
        return data

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data):
        return cls(**{**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__},
                      "tier": DifficultyTier(data["tier"]), "verdict": BenchmarkVerdict(data["verdict"])})


@dataclass
class BenchmarkSummary:
    benchmark_version: str
    mode: str
    total_cases: int
    clean_success_count: int
    partial_success_count: int
    regression_count: int
    failed_unchanged_count: int
    execution_error_count: int
    clean_success_rate: float
    total_runtime_s: float
    tier_breakdown: dict
    rule_breakdown: dict
    results: list[EvaluationResult] = field(default_factory=list)
    dirty_cases: int = 0
    clean_controls: int = 0
    verdict_counts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    duplicate_groups: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self):
        data = asdict(self)
        data.update(schema_version=2, validation_level="geometry_only",
                    results=[r.to_dict() for r in self.results])
        return data
