"""Command-line interface for running KLayout DRC, context processors, and report generators.

Supports fine-grained operations matching the flow graph nodes, as well as end-to-end execution,
with human-readable text and structured JSON output for the DeepSeek Harness subsystem.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .config import (
    DEFAULT_DATA_DIR,
    DEFAULT_FIX_SCRIPT_PATH,
    DEFAULT_GDS_PATH,
    DEFAULT_DRC_SCRIPT_PATH,
    DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_DIR,
    DEFAULT_REPORT_DB_PATH,
    DEFAULT_TEXT_REPORT_PATH,
    DEFAULT_WINDOW_HALO_UM,
    DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR,
    DRCJobConfig,
    DRCError,
    DRCConfigurationError,
)
from .runner import DRCRunner
from .parser import DRCParser
from .reporter import DRCReporter
from .fixer import DRCFixer
from .drc_context import DRCContextProcessor
from .gds_context import GDSContextProcessor
from .knowledge_loader import KnowledgeLoader
from .profile import DRCProfileManager
from .run_manifest import RunSpec
from .single_shot import SingleShotOrchestrator
from .benchmark.generator import BenchmarkGenerator
from .benchmark.manifest import BenchmarkManifestManager
from .benchmark.evaluator import BenchmarkEvaluator
from .benchmark.types import DifficultyTier

DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_DIR: Path = DEFAULT_DATA_DIR / "benchmark_v1"


def execute_benchmark_list(
    benchmark_dir: Path,
    rules: list[str] | None = None,
    tiers: list[str] | None = None,
    limit: int | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """List benchmark cases with filtering options."""
    manifest_path = benchmark_dir / "manifest.json"
    manifest = BenchmarkManifestManager.load(manifest_path)

    parsed_tiers = [DifficultyTier(t.strip().lower()) for t in tiers] if tiers else None
    filtered = BenchmarkManifestManager.filter_cases(manifest, rules=rules, tiers=parsed_tiers, limit=limit)

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "benchmark_version": manifest.benchmark_version,
        "total_manifest_cases": manifest.case_count,
        "filtered_count": len(filtered),
        "cases": [c.to_dict() for c in filtered],
    }


def execute_benchmark_verify(benchmark_dir: Path) -> dict:
    """Verify cryptographic integrity of benchmark GDS files against manifest."""
    manifest_path = benchmark_dir / "manifest.json"
    manifest = BenchmarkManifestManager.load(manifest_path)
    integrity = BenchmarkManifestManager.verify_integrity(manifest, benchmark_dir)
    from .benchmark.acceptance import verify_case
    profile = DRCProfileManager().get_profile("asap7_curated")
    for case in manifest.cases:
        try:
            verify_case(case, benchmark_dir, profile)
        except (ValueError, OSError, DRCError):
            integrity[case.case_id] = False

    failed = [case_id for case_id, ok in integrity.items() if not ok]
    all_ok = len(failed) == 0

    return {
        "status": "success" if all_ok else "failed",
        "benchmark_version": manifest.benchmark_version,
        "total_cases": manifest.case_count,
        "verified_cases": sum(1 for ok in integrity.values() if ok),
        "failed_cases": failed,
        "all_valid": all_ok,
    }


def execute_benchmark_generate(output_dir: Path) -> dict:
    """Deterministically regenerate benchmark dataset and manifest."""
    generator = BenchmarkGenerator()
    manifest = generator.generate_all(output_dir)
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "output_dir": str(output_dir.resolve()),
        "case_count": manifest.case_count,
        "benchmark_version": manifest.benchmark_version,
    }


def execute_benchmark_evaluate(
    benchmark_dir: Path,
    output_dir: Path | None = None,
    candidate_mode: str = "heuristic",
    candidate_script: Path | None = None,
    rules: list[str] | None = None,
    tiers: list[str] | None = None,
    limit: int | None = None,
    profile_name: str = "asap7_curated",
) -> dict:
    """Execute single-shot repair evaluation across benchmark cases."""
    manifest_path = benchmark_dir / "manifest.json"
    manifest = BenchmarkManifestManager.load(manifest_path)

    parsed_tiers = [DifficultyTier(t.strip().lower()) for t in tiers] if tiers else None
    filtered_cases = BenchmarkManifestManager.filter_cases(manifest, rules=rules, tiers=parsed_tiers, limit=limit)

    evaluator = BenchmarkEvaluator(
        base_dir=benchmark_dir,
        output_dir=output_dir,
        profile_name=profile_name,
    )
    summary = evaluator.evaluate_batch(
        cases=filtered_cases,
        mode=candidate_mode,
        candidate_script=candidate_script,
    )
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "output_dir": str(evaluator.output_dir.resolve()),
        "summary": summary.to_dict(),
    }


def run_pipeline(
    input_gds: Path,
    drc_script: Path,
    output_lyrdb: Path,
    text_report_path: Path | None = None,
    profile_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Execute end-to-end DRC check, parse results, and generate textual report."""
    profile_mgr = DRCProfileManager()
    profile = profile_mgr.get_profile(profile_name) if profile_name else profile_mgr.find_profile_for_deck(drc_script)
    config = DRCJobConfig(
        input_gds=input_gds,
        drc_script=drc_script,
        output_lyrdb=output_lyrdb,
        param_in_gds=profile.param_in_gds,
        param_report=profile.param_report,
        extra_params=profile.extra_params,
    )
    runner = DRCRunner(config)
    report_file = runner.run()

    parser = DRCParser()
    data = parser.parse(report_file)

    reporter = DRCReporter(data)
    text_report = reporter.generate_textual_report()

    written_text_path = None
    if text_report_path:
        written_text_path = reporter.write_textual_report(text_report_path)

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "input_gds": str(input_gds.resolve()),
        "drc_script": str(drc_script.resolve()),
        "report_db": str(report_file.resolve()),
        "text_report_file": str(written_text_path.resolve()) if written_text_path else None,
        "total_violations": data.total_violations,
        "rule_summary": reporter.get_summary(),
        "textual_report": text_report,
        "details": data.to_dict(),
    }


def execute_run_drc(
    input_gds: Path,
    drc_script: Path,
    output_lyrdb: Path,
    profile_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Execute DRC batch check only and return database path and violation count."""
    profile_mgr = DRCProfileManager()
    profile = profile_mgr.get_profile(profile_name) if profile_name else profile_mgr.find_profile_for_deck(drc_script)
    config = DRCJobConfig(
        input_gds=input_gds,
        drc_script=drc_script,
        output_lyrdb=output_lyrdb,
        param_in_gds=profile.param_in_gds,
        param_report=profile.param_report,
        extra_params=profile.extra_params,
    )
    runner = DRCRunner(config)
    report_file = runner.run()

    parser = DRCParser()
    data = parser.parse(report_file)
    reporter = DRCReporter(data)

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "input_gds": str(input_gds.resolve()),
        "drc_script": str(drc_script.resolve()),
        "report_db": str(report_file.resolve()),
        "total_violations": data.total_violations,
        "rule_summary": reporter.get_summary(),
    }


def execute_violation_context(report_db: Path, text_report_path: Path | None = None, edit_policy: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Parse .lyrdb database and format formatted textual violations."""
    parser = DRCParser()
    data = parser.parse(report_db)
    if edit_policy:
        from .edit_policy import policy_report
        data = policy_report(data, edit_policy)
    reporter = DRCReporter(data)
    text_report = reporter.generate_textual_report()

    written_text_path = None
    if text_report_path:
        written_text_path = reporter.write_textual_report(text_report_path)

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "report_db": str(report_db.resolve()),
        "total_violations": data.total_violations,
        "rule_summary": reporter.get_summary(),
        "violations_text": text_report,
        "text_report_file": str(written_text_path.resolve()) if written_text_path else None,
    }


def execute_drc_context(drc_script: Path, report_db: Path, edit_policy: Path | None = None,
                        profile_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Extract DRC rule definitions matching violated categories found in .lyrdb."""
    parser = DRCParser()
    data = parser.parse(report_db)
    if edit_policy:
        from .edit_policy import policy_report
        data = policy_report(data, edit_policy)
    reporter = DRCReporter(data)
    violated_rules = list(reporter.get_summary().keys())

    proc = DRCContextProcessor(drc_script)
    rules_text = proc.format_as_text(violated_rules)
    if profile_name == 'asap7_c2c3_v1':
        rules_text += ('\nC2+C3 checker qualification: DBU is 0.25 nm; the manufacturing grid is 1 nm. '
                       'The pinned V1.M2.EN.2 expression has a fine-DBU transition at 5.25 nm. '
                       'For its rectangular end-cap fixtures, a 6 nm cap is legal on the manufacturing grid; '
                       'a 5 nm cap is checker-illegal. Use this verified checker behavior rather than '
                       'the nominal 5 nm description. V2.M3.EN.2 passes with a 5 nm cap on this grid. '
                       'V2.M2.EN.1 requires at least two opposite sides enclosed by 5 nm.\n')

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "drc_script": str(drc_script.resolve()),
        "violated_rules": violated_rules,
        "drc_rules_text": rules_text,
    }


def execute_gds_context(gds_path: Path, report_db: Path, halo_um: float, edit_policy: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Extract local layout windows around violation coordinates."""
    parser = DRCParser()
    data = parser.parse(report_db)

    proc = GDSContextProcessor(gds_path=gds_path, halo_um=halo_um)
    if edit_policy:
        from .edit_policy import policy_context
        sections_text = json.dumps(policy_context(gds_path, json.loads(edit_policy.read_text())), sort_keys=True)
    else:
        sections_text = proc.format_as_text(data)

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "gds_path": str(gds_path.resolve()),
        "halo_um": halo_um,
        "gds_sections_text": sections_text,
    }


def execute_load_knowledge(knowledge_dir: Path, profile_name: str = "legacy_mini") -> dict:
    """Load and concatenate all markdown files from the knowledge directory."""
    loader = KnowledgeLoader(knowledge_dir, profile_name)
    knowledge_text = loader.format_as_text()

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "knowledge_dir": str(knowledge_dir.resolve()),
        "knowledge_text": knowledge_text,
    }


def execute_save_script(script_content: str, output_path: Path) -> dict:
    """Save generated Python script to disk."""
    output_path = Path(output_path).resolve()
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_path.write_text(script_content, encoding="utf-8")

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "saved_path": str(output_path),
    }


def execute_single_shot(
    input_gds: Path,
    drc_script: Path,
    profile_name: str | None = None,
    candidate_mode: str = "heuristic",
    candidate_script: Path | None = None,
    run_id: str | None = None,
    runs_dir: Path = DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR,
) -> dict:
    """Execute single-shot evaluation: preflight DRC -> apply patch -> validate -> recheck -> report."""
    resolved_profile = profile_name or DRCProfileManager().find_profile_for_deck(drc_script).name
    spec = RunSpec(
        case_name=input_gds.stem,
        input_gds=input_gds,
        drc_script=drc_script,
        profile_name=resolved_profile,
        candidate_mode=candidate_mode,
        candidate_script=candidate_script,
        run_id=run_id,
        output_root=runs_dir,
    )
    orchestrator = SingleShotOrchestrator(spec)
    summary = orchestrator.run()

    return {
        "status": "success" if summary.verdict == "success_geometry_only" else summary.verdict,
        "run_id": orchestrator.manifest_manager.run_id,
        "run_dir": str(orchestrator.paths.run_dir),
        "verdict": summary.verdict,
        "validation_level": summary.validation_level,
        "total_violations_before": summary.total_before,
        "total_violations_after": summary.total_after,
        "violations_before": summary.violations_before,
        "violations_after": summary.violations_after,
        "execution_status": summary.execution_result.status,
        "execution_duration": round(summary.execution_result.duration_seconds, 3),
        "error_message": summary.error_message,
        "report_md_file": str(orchestrator.paths.report_md),
        "results_json_file": str(orchestrator.paths.results_json),
    }


def main() -> int:
    """CLI entry point."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run KLayout DRC and context processors for LLM layout repair."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        choices=[
            "full",
            "single-shot",
            "run-drc",
            "violation-ctx",
            "drc-ctx",
            "gds-ctx",
            "load-knowledge",
            "save-script",
            "benchmark-list",
            "benchmark-verify",
            "benchmark-generate",
            "benchmark-evaluate",
        ],
        default="full",
        help="Pipeline mode to execute (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--gds",
        "-g",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_GDS_PATH,
        help="Path to input GDS layout file (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--deck",
        "-d",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_DRC_SCRIPT_PATH,
        help="Path to KLayout DRC script (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--report-db",
        "-r",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_REPORT_DB_PATH,
        help="Path for generated/existing .lyrdb database (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--text-report",
        "-t",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_TEXT_REPORT_PATH,
        help="Path for generated textual report (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--knowledge-dir",
        "-k",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_DIR,
        help="Path to markdown knowledge base directory (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--halo-um",
        type=float,
        default=DEFAULT_WINDOW_HALO_UM,
        help="Halo window margin in micrometers around violations (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-script",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_FIX_SCRIPT_PATH,
        help="Destination path for generated Python fix script (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--script-content",
        type=str,
        help="Content string of Python script when using --mode save-script",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Output structured JSON to stdout instead of standard text.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fix-output",
        type=Path,
        help="If specified (in full mode), programmatically repair violations and output healed GDS.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--candidate-mode",
        choices=["script_file", "heuristic", "agent"],
        default="heuristic",
        help="Repair candidate source mode for single-shot evaluation (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--candidate-script",
        type=Path,
        help="Path to pre-existing Python repair script when using --candidate-mode script_file",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--profile",
        default=None,
        help="DRC execution profile name (default: auto-detected from deck)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--run-id",
        type=str,
        help="Custom run ID override for isolated run directory naming",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--runs-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR,
        help="Root directory for run evaluation bundles (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_DIR,
        help="Root directory containing benchmark dataset (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark-rules",
        type=str,
        help="Comma-separated list of rule families to filter benchmark cases (e.g. M1.W.1,M2.W.1)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark-tiers",
        type=str,
        help="Comma-separated list of difficulty tiers to filter benchmark cases (e.g. isolated,boundary)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark-limit",
        type=int,
        help="Maximum number of benchmark cases to process",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark-output",
        type=Path,
        help="Destination directory for benchmark evaluation results and summaries",
    )

    parser.add_argument("--edit-policy", type=Path, help="Public case edit policy JSON")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.profile and args.deck == DEFAULT_DRC_SCRIPT_PATH and not any(a in sys.argv for a in ("--deck", "-d")):
            args.deck = DRCProfileManager().get_profile(args.profile).deck_path
        # Benchmark mode dispatches
        if args.mode == "benchmark-list":
            rules = [r.strip() for r in args.benchmark_rules.split(",")] if args.benchmark_rules else None
            tiers = [t.strip() for t in args.benchmark_tiers.split(",")] if args.benchmark_tiers else None
            results = execute_benchmark_list(
                benchmark_dir=args.benchmark_dir,
                rules=rules,
                tiers=tiers,
                limit=args.benchmark_limit,
            )
        elif args.mode == "benchmark-verify":
            results = execute_benchmark_verify(benchmark_dir=args.benchmark_dir)
        elif args.mode == "benchmark-generate":
            out_dir = args.benchmark_output or args.benchmark_dir
            results = execute_benchmark_generate(output_dir=out_dir)
        elif args.mode == "benchmark-evaluate":
            rules = [r.strip() for r in args.benchmark_rules.split(",")] if args.benchmark_rules else None
            tiers = [t.strip() for t in args.benchmark_tiers.split(",")] if args.benchmark_tiers else None
            results = execute_benchmark_evaluate(
                benchmark_dir=args.benchmark_dir,
                output_dir=args.benchmark_output,
                candidate_mode=args.candidate_mode,
                candidate_script=args.candidate_script,
                rules=rules,
                tiers=tiers,
                limit=args.benchmark_limit,
                profile_name=args.profile or "asap7_curated",
            )
        elif args.mode == "single-shot":
            results = execute_single_shot(
                input_gds=args.gds,
                drc_script=args.deck,
                profile_name=args.profile,
                candidate_mode=args.candidate_mode,
                candidate_script=args.candidate_script,
                run_id=args.run_id,
                runs_dir=args.runs_dir,
            )
        elif args.mode == "run-drc":
            results = execute_run_drc(args.gds, args.deck, args.report_db, profile_name=args.profile)
        elif args.mode == "violation-ctx":
            results = execute_violation_context(args.report_db, args.text_report, args.edit_policy)
        elif args.mode == "drc-ctx":
            results = execute_drc_context(args.deck, args.report_db, args.edit_policy, args.profile)
        elif args.mode == "gds-ctx":
            results = execute_gds_context(args.gds, args.report_db, args.halo_um, args.edit_policy)
        elif args.mode == "load-knowledge":
            results = execute_load_knowledge(args.knowledge_dir, args.profile or "legacy_mini")
        elif args.mode == "save-script":
            if not args.script_content:
                # Read from stdin if not passed via argument
                content = sys.stdin.read()
            else:
                content = args.script_content
            results = execute_save_script(content, args.output_script)
        else:
            # Full mode
            results = run_pipeline(
                input_gds=args.gds,
                drc_script=args.deck,
                output_lyrdb=args.report_db,
                text_report_path=args.text_report,
                profile_name=args.profile,
            )
            if args.fix_output:
                fixer = DRCFixer(input_gds=args.gds, output_gds=args.fix_output)
                fixed_gds = fixer.fix()
                results["fixed_gds"] = str(fixed_gds.resolve())

        if args.json:
            print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
        else:
            if "violations_text" in results:
                print(results["violations_text"])
            elif "drc_rules_text" in results:
                print(results["drc_rules_text"])
            elif "gds_sections_text" in results:
                print(results["gds_sections_text"])
            elif "knowledge_text" in results:
                print(results["knowledge_text"])
            elif "textual_report" in results:
                print(results["textual_report"])
            elif "saved_path" in results:
                print(f"Script saved to: {results['saved_path']}")
            else:
                print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

        return 0 if results.get("status") == "success" else 1

    except DRCError as exc:
        from .api_reference import APIReferenceError
        detail = {"status": "error", "message": str(exc)}
        if isinstance(exc, APIReferenceError):
            detail['stage'] = 'api_reference'
        if args.json:
            print(json.dumps(detail), file=sys.stderr)
        else:
            print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        if args.json:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "fatal", "message": str(exc)}), file=sys.stderr)
        else:
            print(f"Fatal error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    """Raised when the KLayout engine execution fails."""

"""DRC deck extractor for unbundling KLayout XML macros into executable scripts.

Extracts Ruby DRC DSL text from <klayout-macro> XML envelopes, decodes XML/HTML
entities, and preserves source line provenance.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import html
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from .config import DRCParserError


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExtractedDeck:
    """Represents extracted DRC script content and source provenance."""

    deck_path: Path
    script_text: str
    script_lines: tuple[str, ...]
    is_xml_macro: bool
    text_start_line: int


class DRCDeckExtractor:
    """Unbundles KLayout XML macro files (.lydrc) into raw DRC DSL scripts."""

    def extract(self, deck_path: Path) -> ExtractedDeck:
        """Extract the script DSL from a DRC deck file.

        Args:
            deck_path: Path to the .lydrc XML macro or plain .drc script.

        Returns:
            ExtractedDeck: Extracted script content with line provenance.

        Raises:
            DRCParserError: If the deck file cannot be read, XML is malformed,
                or <text> block is missing.
        """
        deck_path = Path(deck_path).resolve()
        if not deck_path.exists():
            raise DRCParserError(f"DRC deck file does not exist: {deck_path}")

        try:
            with open(deck_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read()
        except OSError as exc:
            raise DRCParserError(f"Could not read DRC deck file {deck_path}: {exc}") from exc

        if "<klayout-macro>" in content:
            return self._extract_from_macro(deck_path, content)

        # Plain DRC script
        lines = tuple(content.splitlines())
        return ExtractedDeck(
            deck_path=deck_path,
            script_text=content,
            script_lines=lines,
            is_xml_macro=False,
            text_start_line=1,
        )

    def _extract_from_macro(self, deck_path: Path, content: str) -> ExtractedDeck:
        """Parse XML macro envelope and extract the <text> element content."""
        # Find start line of <text> in original content for line provenance
        text_start_line = 1
        for idx, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
            if "<text>" in line:
                text_start_line = idx
                break

        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(content)
        except ET.ParseError as exc:
            raise DRCParserError(f"Failed to parse XML macro {deck_path}: {exc}") from exc

        text_elem = root.find("text")
        if text_elem is None or text_elem.text is None:
            raise DRCParserError(f"DRC XML macro {deck_path} does not contain a <text> element.")

        # Decode XML/HTML entities (<, >, &, ")
        raw_text = html.unescape(text_elem.text)
        lines = tuple(raw_text.splitlines())

        return ExtractedDeck(
            deck_path=deck_path,
            script_text=raw_text,
            script_lines=lines,
            is_xml_macro=True,
            text_start_line=text_start_line,
        )

"""DRC rule deck context processor.

Extracts rule definitions, parameter thresholds, and related comments from a DRC deck
matching specific violated rule categories found in the violation database.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Optional, Sequence

from .deck_extractor import DRCDeckExtractor
from .rule_catalog import DRCRuleCatalog
from .config import DRCConfigurationError, DRCParserError


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExtractedRuleInfo:
    """Structured information extracted for a specific DRC rule."""
    rule_name: str
    code_block: str
    comment: Optional[str] = None
    threshold_um: Optional[float] = None


class DRCContextProcessor:
    """Parses DRC decks and extracts contextual rule definitions for violated rules."""

    def __init__(self, drc_script_path: Path | str):
        self.drc_script_path = Path(drc_script_path).resolve()
        if not self.drc_script_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"DRC script not found: {self.drc_script_path}")

    def extract_rules_for_violations(
        self, violated_rule_names: Sequence[str]
    ) -> dict[str, ExtractedRuleInfo]:
        """Extract rule code blocks from the DRC deck for all specified rule names.

        Args:
            violated_rule_names: Sequence of rule category strings (e.g. ['M1_W', 'M1_S']).

        Returns:
            Dictionary mapping rule name to ExtractedRuleInfo.
        """
        try:
            deck_content = DRCDeckExtractor().extract(self.drc_script_path).script_text
        except OSError as e:
            raise DRCParserError(f"Failed to read DRC deck '{self.drc_script_path}': {e}") from e

        catalog = DRCRuleCatalog()
        catalog.bind_deck_provenance(self.drc_script_path)
        extracted: dict[str, ExtractedRuleInfo] = {}
        lines = deck_content.splitlines()

        for rule_name in violated_rule_names:
            audited = catalog.get_rule_by_category(rule_name)
            if audited and audited.source_branches:
                constraints = "; ".join(f"{c.constraint_type}={c.value_um:g} {c.unit}" + (f" ({c.condition})" if c.condition else "") for c in audited.constraints)
                info = ExtractedRuleInfo(rule_name, audited.raw_source_snippet,
                    audited.description + "; " + constraints + f"; source lines {audited.source_line_start}-{audited.source_line_end}",
                    audited.constraints[0].value_um if audited.constraints and audited.constraints[0].unit == "um" else None)
            else:
                info = self._find_rule_in_lines(rule_name, lines)
            if info:
                extracted[rule_name] = info
            else:
                # Fallback if exact pattern not found
                extracted[rule_name] = ExtractedRuleInfo(
                    rule_name=rule_name,
                    code_block=f"# Rule '{rule_name}' was flagged in .lyrdb but exact definition was not isolated in deck",
                )

        return extracted

    def format_as_text(self, violated_rule_names: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        """Format the extracted rule definitions into a structured text prompt section."""
        extracted = self.extract_rules_for_violations(violated_rule_names)

        lines = [
            "=== DRC Rules Context ===",
            f"Source DRC Deck: {self.drc_script_path.name}",
            f"Total Violated Rules to Inspect: {len(violated_rule_names)}",
            "",
        ]

        for rule_name in sorted(violated_rule_names):
            info = extracted.get(rule_name)
            if not info:
                continue

            lines.append(f"--- Rule: {rule_name} ---")
            if info.comment:
                lines.append(f"Description: {info.comment}")
            if info.threshold_um is not None:
                lines.append(f"Constraint Threshold: {info.threshold_um:.8g} um ({info.threshold_um * 1000:.1f} nm)")
            lines.append("Code Definition:")
            for code_line in info.code_block.splitlines():
                lines.append(f"  {code_line}")
            lines.append("")

        return "\n".join(lines).strip()

    def _find_rule_in_lines(self, rule_name: str, lines: list[str]) -> Optional[ExtractedRuleInfo]:
        """Search lines for output declarations matching rule_name."""
        target_idx = -1
        # Match .output("RULE_NAME" or rule "RULE_NAME"
        pattern = re.compile(rf'["\']{re.escape(rule_name)}["\']')

        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            if pattern.search(line):
                target_idx = idx
                break

        if target_idx == -1:
            return None

        # Collect leading comments if any
        comment_lines = []
        c_idx = target_idx - 1
        while c_idx >= 0 and lines[c_idx].strip().startswith("#"):
            comment_lines.insert(0, lines[c_idx].strip().lstrip("#").strip())
            c_idx -= 1

        comment = " ".join(comment_lines) if comment_lines else None

        # Extract code line or block
        code_line = lines[target_idx].strip()

        # Try to extract numerical threshold (e.g. 0.018 or 18.nm)
        threshold_match = re.search(r'\((\d+\.?\d*)\s*,', code_line)
        threshold_um = float(threshold_match.group(1)) if threshold_match else None

        return ExtractedRuleInfo(
            rule_name=rule_name,
            code_block=code_line,
            comment=comment,
            threshold_um=threshold_um,
        )

"""Programmatic repair tool for ASAP7 DRC violations using KLayout geometric APIs.

Implements automated healing for width, spacing, and via enclosure errors
using Region boolean and morphological operations.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import klayout.db as db

from .config import (
    LAYER_M1,
    LAYER_V1,
    ASAP7_M1_MIN_WIDTH_UM,
    ASAP7_V1_M1_MIN_ENCLOSURE_UM,
    DRCConfigurationError,
)


class DRCFixer:
    """Repairs geometric violations on M1 and V1 layers programmatically."""

    def __init__(self, input_gds: Path, output_gds: Path) -> None:
        """Initialize fixer with input and output file paths.
        
        Args:
            input_gds: Path to the layout containing violations.
            output_gds: Path where the repaired layout will be written.
        """
        self.input_gds = input_gds.resolve()
        self.output_gds = output_gds.resolve()
        if not self.input_gds.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Input GDS not found: {self.input_gds}")

    def fix(self) -> Path:
        """Execute geometric healing and write the repaired layout.
        
        Returns:
            Path: Path to the repaired GDS layout.
        """
        layout = db.Layout()
        layout.read(str(self.input_gds))
        top_cell = layout.top_cell()
        dbu = layout.dbu

        m1_layer = layout.layer(*LAYER_M1)
        v1_layer = layout.layer(*LAYER_V1)

        m1_shapes = top_cell.shapes(m1_layer)
        v1_shapes = top_cell.shapes(v1_layer)

        m1_reg = db.Region(m1_shapes)
        v1_reg = db.Region(v1_shapes)

        # 1. Fix Enclosure: Expand M1 to cover V1 by minimum enclosure (9nm)
        enc_dbu = int(round(ASAP7_V1_M1_MIN_ENCLOSURE_UM / dbu))
        m1_reg = m1_reg | v1_reg.sized(enc_dbu)

        # 2. Fix Spacing: Merge wires closer than minimum spacing (18nm) using morphological dilation/erosion
        merge_dbu = int(round((ASAP7_M1_MIN_WIDTH_UM / 2.0) / dbu))
        m1_reg = m1_reg.sized(merge_dbu).sized(-merge_dbu)

        # 3. Fix Width: Expand narrow regions (< 18nm) by adding sized width-check error markers
        min_width_dbu = int(round(ASAP7_M1_MIN_WIDTH_UM / dbu))
        width_boost_dbu = int(round(0.005 / dbu))
        error_edges = m1_reg.width_check(min_width_dbu)
        m1_reg = m1_reg | error_edges.polygons(0).sized(width_boost_dbu)

        # Replace shapes on M1 with healed region
        m1_shapes.clear()
        m1_shapes.insert(m1_reg)

        self.output_gds.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        layout.write(str(self.output_gds))
        return self.output_gds

"""GDS layout context processor.

Extracts local geometric bounding-box windows around violation coordinates with a configurable halo,
formatting the local layout polygon geometry and layer information into structured text for LLMs.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Optional

import klayout.db as db

from .config import (
    ASAP7_DBU_UM,
    DEFAULT_WINDOW_HALO_UM,
    DRCConfigurationError,
    DRCParserError,
)
from .parser import DRCReportData, ViolationItem


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PolygonGeometry:
    """Representation of an extracted layout polygon in micrometers."""
    layer: int
    datatype: int
    points_um: list[tuple[float, float]]
    bbox_um: tuple[float, float, float, float]
    shape_type: str = "polygon"
    source_cell: str = ""
    holes_um: list[list[tuple[float, float]]] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ViolationNeighborhoodWindow:
    """A localized inspection window containing surrounding layout geometry around a violation."""
    violation_index: int
    rule_name: str
    cell_name: str
    marker_bbox_um: tuple[float, float, float, float]
    window_bbox_um: tuple[float, float, float, float]
    polygons: list[PolygonGeometry] = field(default_factory=list)
    is_truncated: bool = False
    omitted_windows: int = 0


class GDSContextProcessor:
    """Inspects GDS layout geometry around violation coordinates and extracts structured sections."""

    def __init__(self, gds_path: Path | str, halo_um: float = DEFAULT_WINDOW_HALO_UM):
        self.gds_path = Path(gds_path).resolve()
        if not self.gds_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"GDS file not found: {self.gds_path}")
        self.halo_um = halo_um

    def extract_windows_for_report(
        self,
        report_data: DRCReportData,
        max_windows_per_rule: int = 3,
    ) -> list[ViolationNeighborhoodWindow]:
        """Extract geometric neighborhood windows around violation coordinates.

        Args:
            report_data: Parsed DRC report data.
            max_windows_per_rule: Maximum number of violation windows per rule to avoid context explosion.

        Returns:
            List of ViolationNeighborhoodWindow objects containing local shapes.
        """
        try:
            layout = db.Layout()
            layout.read(str(self.gds_path))
        except Exception as e:
            raise DRCParserError(f"Failed to read GDS layout '{self.gds_path}': {e}") from e

        top_cell = layout.top_cell()
        if top_cell is None:
            raise DRCParserError(f"GDS layout '{self.gds_path}' does not have a top cell.")

        dbu = layout.dbu if layout.dbu > 0 else ASAP7_DBU_UM
        windows: list[ViolationNeighborhoodWindow] = []

        rule_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for cat in report_data.categories:
            for item in cat.violations:
                current_count = rule_counts.get(cat.name, 0)
                if current_count >= max_windows_per_rule:
                    continue
                rule_counts[cat.name] = current_count + 1

                window = self._extract_single_window(layout, top_cell, item, cat.name, dbu)
                if window:
                    windows.append(window)

        # Window caps are a separate loss of context from the shape cap.
        from dataclasses import replace
        omitted = sum(max(0, len(c.violations)-max_windows_per_rule) for c in report_data.categories)
        return [replace(window, omitted_windows=omitted) for window in windows]

    def format_as_text(
        self,
        report_data: DRCReportData,
        max_windows_per_rule: int = 3,
    ) -> str:
        """Format the extracted layout windows into a structured text prompt."""
        windows = self.extract_windows_for_report(report_data, max_windows_per_rule)

        lines = [
            "=== GDS Layout Context (Violation Neighborhood Windows) ===",
            f"Layout File: {self.gds_path.name}",
            f"Window Halo Margin: {self.halo_um * 1000:.1f} nm ({self.halo_um:.9f} um)",
            f"Total Neighborhood Windows Extracted: {len(windows)}",
            f"Omitted marker windows: {sum(max(0, len(c.violations)-max_windows_per_rule) for c in report_data.categories)}",
            f"Layout DBU (um): {self._layout_dbu():.12g}",
            "",
        ]

        for win in windows:
            lines.append(
                f"--- Window {win.violation_index}: Rule {win.rule_name} (Cell: {win.cell_name}) ---"
            )
            lines.append(
                f"Violation Marker Box (um): [{win.marker_bbox_um[0]:.9f}, {win.marker_bbox_um[1]:.9f}] to [{win.marker_bbox_um[2]:.9f}, {win.marker_bbox_um[3]:.9f}]"
            )
            lines.append(
                f"Inspection Window (um):    [{win.window_bbox_um[0]:.9f}, {win.window_bbox_um[1]:.9f}] to [{win.window_bbox_um[2]:.9f}, {win.window_bbox_um[3]:.9f}]"
            )
            lines.append(f"Intersecting Shapes Count: {len(win.polygons)}")
            if win.is_truncated:
                lines.append("  [Note: Context truncated at shape limit]")

            if not win.polygons:
                lines.append("  (No intersecting shapes found on active layers within halo)")
            else:
                for idx, poly in enumerate(win.polygons, start=1):
                    cell_info = f" [Cell: {poly.source_cell}]" if poly.source_cell and poly.source_cell != win.cell_name else ""
                    lines.append(
                        f"  Shape {idx}: Layer {poly.layer}/{poly.datatype} ({poly.shape_type}){cell_info}"
                    )
                    lines.append(
                        f"    BBox (um): [{poly.bbox_um[0]:.9f}, {poly.bbox_um[1]:.9f}] to [{poly.bbox_um[2]:.9f}, {poly.bbox_um[3]:.9f}]"
                    )
                    pts_str = ", ".join(f"({x:.9f}, {y:.9f})" for x, y in poly.points_um)
                    lines.append(f"    Vertices (um): [{pts_str}]")
                    for hole in poly.holes_um:
                        lines.append("    Hole vertices (um): " + str(hole))

            lines.append("")

        return "\n".join(lines).strip()

    def _extract_single_window(
        self,
        layout: db.Layout,
        cell: db.Cell,
        item: ViolationItem,
        rule_name: str,
        dbu: float,
    ) -> Optional[ViolationNeighborhoodWindow]:
        """Compute window bounding box and gather intersecting shapes hierarchically."""
        marker_bboxes: list[tuple[float, float, float, float]] = []
        for geom in item.geometries:
            if geom.bbox_um is not None:
                marker_bboxes.append(geom.bbox_um)
            else:
                numbers = [float(n) for n in re.findall(r"[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", geom.representation)]
                if len(numbers) >= 2:
                    xs = [numbers[i] for i in range(0, len(numbers) - 1, 2)]
                    ys = [numbers[i + 1] for i in range(0, len(numbers) - 1, 2)]
                    marker_bboxes.append((min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys)))

        if not marker_bboxes:
            return None

        min_x = min(b[0] for b in marker_bboxes)
        min_y = min(b[1] for b in marker_bboxes)
        max_x = max(b[2] for b in marker_bboxes)
        max_y = max(b[3] for b in marker_bboxes)

        marker_bbox = (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y)
        win_min_x = min_x - self.halo_um
        win_min_y = min_y - self.halo_um
        win_max_x = max_x + self.halo_um
        win_max_y = max_y + self.halo_um
        window_bbox = (win_min_x, win_min_y, win_max_x, win_max_y)

        # Build search box in integer DBU
        box_dbu = db.Box(
            int(round(win_min_x / dbu)),
            int(round(win_min_y / dbu)),
            int(round(win_max_x / dbu)),
            int(round(win_max_y / dbu)),
        )

        extracted_polys: list[PolygonGeometry] = []
        is_truncated = False
        max_shapes = 50

        # Iterate hierarchically through all layout layers using RecursiveShapeIterator
        for layer_info in layout.layer_infos():
            layer_idx = layout.layer(layer_info)
            iter = cell.begin_shapes_rec_overlapping(layer_idx, box_dbu)

            while not iter.at_end():
                if len(extracted_polys) >= max_shapes:
                    is_truncated = True
                    break

                shape = iter.shape()
                itrans = iter.itrans()
                source_cell = iter.cell().name if iter.cell() else cell.name

                if shape.is_box():
                    b = shape.box.transformed(itrans)
                    pts = [
                        (b.left * dbu, b.bottom * dbu),
                        (b.right * dbu, b.bottom * dbu),
                        (b.right * dbu, b.top * dbu),
                        (b.left * dbu, b.top * dbu),
                    ]
                    poly_bbox = (b.left * dbu, b.bottom * dbu, b.right * dbu, b.top * dbu)
                    extracted_polys.append(
                        PolygonGeometry(
                            layer=layer_info.layer,
                            datatype=layer_info.datatype,
                            points_um=pts,
                            bbox_um=poly_bbox,
                            shape_type="box",
                            source_cell=source_cell,
                        )
                    )
                elif shape.is_polygon():
                    p = shape.polygon.transformed(itrans)
                    pts = [(pt.x * dbu, pt.y * dbu) for pt in p.each_point_hull()]
                    b = p.bbox()
                    poly_bbox = (b.left * dbu, b.bottom * dbu, b.right * dbu, b.top * dbu)
                    extracted_polys.append(
                        PolygonGeometry(
                            layer=layer_info.layer,
                            datatype=layer_info.datatype,
                            points_um=pts,
                            bbox_um=poly_bbox,
                            shape_type="polygon",
                            source_cell=source_cell,
                            holes_um=[[(pt.x*dbu, pt.y*dbu) for pt in p.each_point_hole(h)] for h in range(p.holes())],
                        )
                    )
                elif shape.is_path():
                    p = shape.path.polygon().transformed(itrans)
                    pts = [(pt.x * dbu, pt.y * dbu) for pt in p.each_point_hull()]
                    b = p.bbox()
                    poly_bbox = (b.left * dbu, b.bottom * dbu, b.right * dbu, b.top * dbu)
                    extracted_polys.append(
                        PolygonGeometry(
                            layer=layer_info.layer,
                            datatype=layer_info.datatype,
                            points_um=pts,
                            bbox_um=poly_bbox,
                            shape_type="path",
                            source_cell=source_cell,
                        )
                    )

                iter.next()

            if is_truncated:
                break

        return ViolationNeighborhoodWindow(
            violation_index=item.item_id,
            rule_name=rule_name,
            cell_name=item.cell_name or cell.name,
            marker_bbox_um=marker_bbox,
            window_bbox_um=window_bbox,
            polygons=extracted_polys,
            is_truncated=is_truncated,
        )

    def _layout_dbu(self):
        layout = db.Layout(); layout.read(str(self.gds_path))
        return layout.dbu

"""Knowledge base loader for DRC domain guidelines.

Discovers and loads Markdown knowledge files from a directory, providing structured context
to guide LLM generation of layout repair scripts.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from .config import DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_DIR, DRCConfigurationError


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class KnowledgeDocument:
    """A loaded knowledge base markdown file."""
    title: str
    filename: str
    content: str


class KnowledgeLoader:
    """Discovers and merges domain knowledge markdown documents."""

    def __init__(self, knowledge_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_DIR, profile_name: str = "legacy_mini"):
        self.knowledge_dir = Path(knowledge_dir).resolve()
        from .profile import DRCProfileManager
        self.profile = DRCProfileManager().get_profile(profile_name)

    def load_documents(self) -> list[KnowledgeDocument]:
        """Load Markdown and supply the canonical API document exactly once."""
        if not self.knowledge_dir.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(
                f"Knowledge directory does not exist: {self.knowledge_dir}"
            )

        md_files = sorted(self.knowledge_dir.glob("*.md"))
        documents: list[KnowledgeDocument] = []
        from .api_reference import render_api_reference
        reference = render_api_reference()

        for md_file in md_files:
            try:
                # This reserved document is generated from tested package code.
                # A custom directory cannot replace it with stale API guidance.
                content = reference if md_file.name == 'klayout_api_patterns.md' else md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                replacements = {
                    "{{M1_LAYER}}": str(self.profile.layers["M1"][0]),
                    "{{V1_LAYER}}": str(self.profile.layers["V1"][0]),
                    "{{PROFILE}}": self.profile.name,
                }
                for token, value in replacements.items():
                    content = content.replace(token, value)
                if md_file.name == "asap7_rules_guide.md":
                    content += "\n" + self._technology_facts()
                # Determine title from first H1 header or filename
                title = md_file.stem.replace("_", " ").title()
                for line in content.splitlines():
                    if line.startswith("# "):
                        title = line.lstrip("#").strip()
                        break

                documents.append(
                    KnowledgeDocument(
                        title=title,
                        filename=md_file.name,
                        content=content if md_file.name == 'klayout_api_patterns.md' else content.strip(),
                    )
                )
            except OSError as e:
                raise DRCConfigurationError(
                    f"Failed to read knowledge file '{md_file}': {e}"
                ) from e

        if not any(doc.filename == 'klayout_api_patterns.md' for doc in documents):
            documents.append(KnowledgeDocument('KLayout Python API: layout repair and hierarchy',
                                               'klayout_api_patterns.md', reference))
        return sorted(documents, key=lambda doc: (doc.filename != 'klayout_api_patterns.md', doc.filename))

    def format_as_text(self) -> str:
        """Format all loaded knowledge documents into a consolidated prompt context block."""
        docs = self.load_documents()

        lines = [
            "=== Domain Knowledge Base ===",
            self._technology_facts(),
            f"Source Directory: {self.knowledge_dir.name}/",
            f"Documents Loaded: {len(docs)}",
            "",
        ]

        if not docs:
            lines.append("(No knowledge documents found in directory)")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        for doc in docs:
            lines.append(f"--- Document: {doc.title} ({doc.filename}) ---")
            lines.append(doc.content)
            lines.append("")

        return "\n".join(lines).rstrip('\n') + '\n'

    def _technology_facts(self):
        profile = self.profile
        layers = "; ".join(f"{name}={layer}/{datatype}" for name, (layer, datatype) in profile.layers.items())
        return (f"# ASAP7 Process Design Kit: active profile {profile.name}\n"
                f"Layers: {layers}\n"
                f"Profile DBU: {profile.dbu_um:.12g} um; manufacturing grid: {profile.manufacturing_grid_um:.12g} um. "
                "Read actual layout.dbu for conversions. Never infer physical layers from examples.\n"
                "Rule thresholds and units come from the active decoded deck context. "
                "No net ownership or electrical correctness is established. Preserve clean inputs.\n")

"""Geometric layout difference calculator.

Computes layer-by-layer geometric diffs (added area, removed area, unchanged area)
between an immutable reference GDS and a patched candidate GDS.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
import klayout.db as db


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LayerDiff:
    """Geometric diff summary for a single GDS layer/datatype."""

    layer: int
    datatype: int
    added_area_um2: float
    removed_area_um2: float
    unchanged_area_um2: float

    @property
    def has_changes(self) -> bool:
        """True if any area was added or removed on this layer."""
        return self.added_area_um2 > 1e-12 or self.removed_area_um2 > 1e-12

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        """Convert layer diff to dictionary."""
        return {
            "layer": self.layer,
            "datatype": self.datatype,
            "added_area_um2": self.added_area_um2,
            "removed_area_um2": self.removed_area_um2,
            "unchanged_area_um2": self.unchanged_area_um2,
            "has_changes": self.has_changes,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LayoutDiffReport:
    """Aggregate layout difference metrics across all layers."""

    total_added_area_um2: float
    total_removed_area_um2: float
    net_area_delta_um2: float
    modified_layers: list[tuple[int, int]]
    layer_diffs: list[LayerDiff] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        """Convert diff report to dictionary."""
        return {
            "total_added_area_um2": self.total_added_area_um2,
            "total_removed_area_um2": self.total_removed_area_um2,
            "net_area_delta_um2": self.net_area_delta_um2,
            "modified_layers": [list(ly) for ly in self.modified_layers],
            "layer_diffs": [ld.to_dict() for ld in self.layer_diffs],
        }


class LayoutDiffCalculator:
    """Computes exact geometric polygon differences between reference and patched layouts."""

    def __init__(self, reference_gds: Path, patched_gds: Path) -> None:
        """Initialize with reference and patched GDS paths.

        Args:
            reference_gds: Original baseline layout.
            patched_gds: Patched layout.
        """
        self.reference_gds = Path(reference_gds).resolve()
        self.patched_gds = Path(patched_gds).resolve()

    def compute_diff(self) -> LayoutDiffReport:
        """Compute layer-by-layer polygon diffs and return LayoutDiffReport."""
        ref_layout = db.Layout()
        ref_layout.read(str(self.reference_gds))
        ref_top = ref_layout.top_cell()
        ref_dbu = ref_layout.dbu

        patch_layout = db.Layout()
        patch_layout.read(str(self.patched_gds))
        patch_top = patch_layout.top_cell()
        patch_dbu = patch_layout.dbu

        # Collect union of all layer/datatype pairs
        all_layer_infos: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
        for idx in ref_layout.layer_indexes():
            info = ref_layout.get_info(idx)
            all_layer_infos.add((info.layer, info.datatype))
        for idx in patch_layout.layer_indexes():
            info = patch_layout.get_info(idx)
            all_layer_infos.add((info.layer, info.datatype))

        layer_diffs: list[LayerDiff] = []
        total_added = 0.0
        total_removed = 0.0
        modified_layers: list[tuple[int, int]] = []

        for layer_num, datatype in sorted(all_layer_infos):
            ref_region = db.Region()
            if ref_top:
                ref_idx = ref_layout.find_layer(layer_num, datatype)
                if ref_idx is not None:
                    ref_region = db.Region(ref_top.begin_shapes_rec(ref_idx)).merged()

            patch_region = db.Region()
            if patch_top:
                patch_idx = patch_layout.find_layer(layer_num, datatype)
                if patch_idx is not None:
                    patch_region = db.Region(patch_top.begin_shapes_rec(patch_idx)).merged()

            # Rescale regions if DBUs differ
            if abs(ref_dbu - patch_dbu) > 1e-9:
                ref_region = ref_region.transformed(db.ICplxTrans(ref_dbu / patch_dbu))
                scale_to_um2 = patch_dbu * patch_dbu
            else:
                scale_to_um2 = patch_dbu * patch_dbu

            added_region = patch_region - ref_region
            removed_region = ref_region - patch_region
            unchanged_region = ref_region & patch_region

            added_area_um2 = added_region.area() * scale_to_um2
            removed_area_um2 = removed_region.area() * scale_to_um2
            unchanged_area_um2 = unchanged_region.area() * scale_to_um2

            diff = LayerDiff(
                layer=layer_num,
                datatype=datatype,
                added_area_um2=added_area_um2,
                removed_area_um2=removed_area_um2,
                unchanged_area_um2=unchanged_area_um2,
            )
            layer_diffs.append(diff)
            total_added += added_area_um2
            total_removed += removed_area_um2
            if diff.has_changes:
                modified_layers.append((layer_num, datatype))

        return LayoutDiffReport(
            total_added_area_um2=total_added,
            total_removed_area_um2=total_removed,
            net_area_delta_um2=total_added - total_removed,
            modified_layers=modified_layers,
            layer_diffs=layer_diffs,
        )

"""DRC Profile definition and manager for technology-specific rule decks.

Provides typed models for selecting deck parameter variable names, PDK layer mappings,
and database unit (DBU) conventions.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

from .config import (
    DEFAULT_RULES_DIR,
    DRCConfigurationError,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DRCProfile:
    """Configuration profile for a specific DRC deck and PDK technology ruleset."""

    name: str
    description: str
    deck_path: Path
    param_in_gds: str = "input"
    param_report: str = "report"
    extra_params: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    layers: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    dbu_um: float = 0.001
    manufacturing_grid_um: float = 0.00025
    editable_layers: tuple[str, ...] = ("M1", "V1")
    protected_cells: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def validate(self) -> None:
        """Validate profile parameters and ensure deck file exists."""
        if not self.deck_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"DRC profile deck file does not exist: {self.deck_path}")


class DRCProfileManager:
    """Registry and loader for technology-specific DRC execution profiles."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize registry with built-in profiles."""
        self._profiles: dict[str, DRCProfile] = {}
        self._register_builtins()

    def _register_builtins(self) -> None:
        """Register default built-in profiles for legacy mini and ASAP7."""
        legacy_mini = DRCProfile(
            name="legacy_mini",
            description="Synthetic ASAP7 3-rule mini DRC deck with legacy layer conventions",
            deck_path=DEFAULT_RULES_DIR / "asap7_mini.drc",
            param_in_gds="input",
            param_report="report",

            dbu_um=0.001,

        )
        self.register_profile(legacy_mini)

        asap7_curated = DRCProfile(
            name="asap7_curated",
            description="Audited subset of 5 BEOL rule families with authentic layer conventions",
            deck_path=DEFAULT_RULES_DIR / "asap7_curated.lydrc",

            dbu_um=0.00025,
            manufacturing_grid_um=0.00025,
            editable_layers=("V0", "M1", "M2", "V1"),
        )
        self.register_profile(asap7_curated)

        self.register_profile(DRCProfile(
            name="asap7_c2c3_v1",
            description="C2+C3 v1 scored BEOL rules, qualified independently from C1",
            deck_path=DEFAULT_RULES_DIR / "asap7_c2c3_v1.lydrc",
            param_in_gds="in_gds", param_report="report_file",
            layers={"M1": (19, 0), "M2": (20, 0), "V1": (21, 0), "V2": (25, 0), "M3": (30, 0)},
            dbu_um=.00025, manufacturing_grid_um=.001,
            editable_layers=("M1", "M2", "V1", "V2", "M3"),
        ))

        asap7_public = DRCProfile(
            name="asap7_public_full",
            description="Public ASAP7 KLayout DRC deck with authentic PDK layer conventions",
            deck_path=DEFAULT_RULES_DIR / "asap7.lydrc",
            param_in_gds="in_gds",
            param_report="report_file",
            layers={
                "V0": (18, 0),
                "M1": (19, 0),
                "M2": (20, 0),
                "V1": (21, 0),
                "V2": (25, 0),
                "M3": (30, 0),
                "V3": (35, 0),
                "M4": (40, 0),
            },
            dbu_um=0.00025,
            manufacturing_grid_um=0.00025,
            editable_layers=("V0", "M1", "M2", "V1", "V2", "M3", "V3", "M4"),
        )
        self.register_profile(asap7_public)

    def register_profile(self, profile: DRCProfile) -> None:
        """Register a new DRC profile in the registry."""
        self._profiles[profile.name] = profile

    def get_profile(self, name: str) -> DRCProfile:
        """Retrieve a registered profile by name.

        Args:
            name: Name identifier of the profile.

        Raises:
            DRCConfigurationError: If profile name is not found.
        """
        if name not in self._profiles:
            available = ", ".join(self._profiles.keys())
            raise DRCConfigurationError(
                f"DRC profile '{name}' not found. Available profiles: {available}"
            )
        return self._profiles[name]

    def find_profile_for_deck(self, deck_path: Path) -> DRCProfile:
        """Find the matching profile for a given deck path, or return legacy_mini as fallback."""
        deck_name = Path(deck_path).name
        for profile in self._profiles.values():
            if profile.deck_path.name == deck_name:
                return profile
        if Path(deck_path).exists():
            try:
                content = Path(deck_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if "$in_gds" in content:
                    return self.get_profile("asap7_curated" if "curated" in deck_name else "asap7_public_full")
            except Exception:
                pass
        return self.get_profile("legacy_mini")

    def list_profiles(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return names of all registered profiles."""
        return list(self._profiles.keys())

    def load_from_yaml(self, yaml_path: Path) -> DRCProfile:
        """Load and register a DRC profile from a YAML file.

        Args:
            yaml_path: Path to the YAML profile specification.

        Raises:
            DRCConfigurationError: If file cannot be read or lacks required fields.
        """
        yaml_path = Path(yaml_path).resolve()
        if not yaml_path.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Profile YAML file does not exist: {yaml_path}")

        try:
            with open(yaml_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = yaml.safe_load(f)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Failed to parse profile YAML: {exc}") from exc

        required = ["name", "deck_path"]
        for key in required:
            if key not in data:
                raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Missing required profile field: {key}")

        deck_path = Path(data["deck_path"])
        if not deck_path.is_absolute():
            deck_path = (yaml_path.parent / deck_path).resolve()

        layers_raw = data.get("layers", {})
        layers = {k: tuple(v) for k, v in layers_raw.items()}

        editable_layers = tuple(data.get("editable_layers", ("M1", "V1")))
        protected_cells = tuple(data.get("protected_cells", ()))

        profile = DRCProfile(
            name=data["name"],
            description=data.get("description", ""),
            deck_path=deck_path,
            param_in_gds=data.get("param_in_gds", "input"),
            param_report=data.get("param_report", "report"),
            extra_params=data.get("extra_params", {}),
            layers=layers,
            dbu_um=float(data.get("dbu_um", 0.001)),
            manufacturing_grid_um=float(data.get("manufacturing_grid_um", 0.00025)),
            editable_layers=editable_layers,
            protected_cells=protected_cells,
        )
        self.register_profile(profile)
        return profile

"""Formats DRC violation data into human-readable text reports and summary structures.

Provides the reporter responsible for generating textual violation details,
bounding box / polygon coordinates, and category totals.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from .parser import DRCReportData


class DRCReporter:
    """Generates textual reports and summary representations from DRCReportData."""

    def __init__(self, data: DRCReportData) -> None:
        """Initialize with parsed DRC report data.
        
        Args:
            data: Structured DRC report data.
        """
        self.data = data

    def generate_textual_report(self) -> str:
        """Format a detailed human-readable report.
        
        Returns:
            str: Multi-line textual summary with coordinates and rule descriptions.
        """
        lines: list[str] = [
            "=== DRC Violations Details ===",
            f"Source: {self.data.source_path}",
        ]

        if not self.data.categories:
            lines.append("\nNo DRC violations found.")
            lines.append("\n==============================")
            lines.append("Total Violations: 0\n")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        for category in self.data.categories:
            lines.append(f"\nRule: {category.name} - {category.description}")
            lines.append(f"  -> {category.count} violation(s) found:")
            for item in category.violations:
                cell_info = f" (Cell: {item.cell_name})" if item.cell_name else ""
                lines.append(f"    Violation {item.item_id}{cell_info}:")
                for geo in item.geometries:
                    label = geo.kind.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(f"      {label}: {geo.representation}")

        lines.append("\n==============================")
        lines.append(f"Total Violations: {self.data.total_violations}\n")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def write_textual_report(self, target_path: Path) -> Path:
        """Write the textual report to a file on disk.
        
        Args:
            target_path: Destination path for the report file.
            
        Returns:
            Path: The resolved path to the written file.
        """
        resolved_path = target_path.resolve()
        resolved_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        report_text = self.generate_textual_report()
        resolved_path.write_text(report_text, encoding="utf-8")
        return resolved_path

    def get_summary(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        """Return a mapping of rule names to violation counts."""
        return {cat.name: cat.count for cat in self.data.categories}

Maintains canonical definitions, physical constraints, layer bindings, and handles

@dataclass(frozen=True)

    constraint_type: str  # "min_width", "min_spacing", "min_area", "min_enclosure"

class DRCRuleCatalog:
    """Audited catalog of DRC rules indexing categories, layers, and constraints."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize catalog with audited rules."""
        self._rules_by_id: dict[str, DRCRuleDefinition] = dict(ASAP7_AUDITED_RULES)
        self._category_to_id: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._rebuild_indices()

    def _rebuild_indices(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild secondary lookup indices."""
        self._category_to_id.clear()
        for rule_id, rule in self._rules_by_id.items():
            self._category_to_id[rule.category_name] = rule_id
            # Also index trimmed category name
            stripped = rule.category_name.strip()
            if stripped and stripped not in self._category_to_id:
                self._category_to_id[stripped] = rule_id

    def register_rule(self, rule: DRCRuleDefinition) -> None:
        """Register or override a rule definition."""
        self._rules_by_id[rule.rule_id] = rule
        self._rebuild_indices()

    def get_rule_by_id(self, rule_id: str) -> DRCRuleDefinition | None:
        """Look up rule definition by canonical rule ID."""
        return self._rules_by_id.get(rule_id)

    def get_rule_by_category(self, category_name: str) -> DRCRuleDefinition | None:
        """Look up rule definition by checker category string.

        Handles whitespace anomalies (e.g. '  ' -> M1.S.2).
        """
        if category_name in self._category_to_id:
            rule_id = self._category_to_id[category_name]
            return self._rules_by_id.get(rule_id)

        # Check if stripped whitespace maps to M1.S.2 anomaly
        if not category_name.strip():
            return self._rules_by_id.get("M1.S.2")

        stripped = category_name.strip()
        if stripped in self._category_to_id:
            rule_id = self._category_to_id[stripped]
            return self._rules_by_id.get(rule_id)

        return None

    def get_rules_for_layer(self, layer_name: str) -> list[DRCRuleDefinition]:
        """Return all rules applicable to a given physical layer."""
        return [
            rule for rule in self._rules_by_id.values()
            if layer_name in rule.target_layers
        ]

    def bind_deck_provenance(self, deck_path: Path) -> None:
        """Scan an extracted DRC deck to bind source line ranges and snippets to catalog rules.

        Args:
            deck_path: Path to the .lydrc or .drc deck.
        """
        extractor = DRCDeckExtractor()
        extracted: ExtractedDeck = extractor.extract(deck_path)

        # Rebinding must not retain branches from a different deck.
        for rule_id, rule in list(self._rules_by_id.items()):
            branches = []
            for index, line in enumerate(extracted.script_lines):
                if f'.output("{rule.category_name}"' not in line:
                    continue
                start = index
                while start > 0 and extracted.script_lines[start-1].strip():
                    start -= 1
                actual_line = extracted.text_start_line + start if extracted.is_xml_macro else start+1
                branches.append((actual_line, "\n".join(extracted.script_lines[start:index+1])))
            if branches:
                first = branches[0][0]
                last = branches[-1][0] + len(branches[-1][1].splitlines()) - 1
                self.register_rule(replace(rule, source_deck=deck_path.name,
                    source_line_start=first, source_line_end=last,
                    raw_source_snippet="\n\n".join(source for _, source in branches),
                    source_branches=tuple(branches)))

"""Run specification and manifest manager for single-shot DRC evaluation.

Provides immutable input snapshotting, SHA-256 file hashing, environment capture,
and isolated run directory creation under reports/runs/<run_id>/.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import hashlib
import json
import re
import klayout.db as db
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from typing import Any

from .config import (
    DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR,
    DRCConfigurationError,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunSpec:
    """Input specifications for an evaluation run."""

    case_name: str
    input_gds: Path
    drc_script: Path
    profile_name: str = "legacy_mini"
    candidate_mode: str = "heuristic"
    candidate_script: Path | None = None
    top_cell: str | None = None
    run_id: str | None = None
    output_root: Path = DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR

    expected_counts: dict[str, int] | None = None
    expected_markers: list | None = None
    preservation: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    edit_policy: dict | None = None

    def validate(self) -> None:
        """Validate input paths and options."""
        if self.run_id and not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", self.run_id):
            raise DRCConfigurationError("Run ID must be a single safe name")
        if self.candidate_mode not in ("agent", "heuristic", "script_file"):
            raise DRCConfigurationError("Unknown candidate mode")
        if not self.input_gds.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"Input GDS does not exist: {self.input_gds}")
        if not self.drc_script.exists():
            raise DRCConfigurationError(f"DRC script does not exist: {self.drc_script}")
        if self.candidate_mode == "script_file" and (
            not self.candidate_script or not self.candidate_script.exists()
        ):
            raise DRCConfigurationError(
                f"Candidate script file not provided or does not exist: {self.candidate_script}"
            )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunPaths:
    """Canonical file paths within an isolated run bundle directory."""

    run_dir: Path
    input_gds: Path
    before_lyrdb: Path
    candidate_script: Path
    candidate_stdout: Path
    candidate_stderr: Path
    patched_gds: Path
    after_lyrdb: Path
    layout_diff_json: Path
    results_json: Path
    report_md: Path
    run_manifest_json: Path


class RunManifestManager:
    """Creates isolated run directories, snapshots inputs, and writes manifest metadata."""

    def __init__(self, spec: RunSpec) -> None:
        """Initialize with validated RunSpec."""
        spec.validate()
        self.spec = spec
        self.run_id = self._generate_run_id()
        self.run_dir = (self.spec.output_root / self.run_id).resolve()
        self.paths = self._build_paths()

    def _generate_run_id(self) -> str:
        """Generate a run ID matching the agreed pattern: <case_name>_<timestamp>_<short_id>."""
        if self.spec.run_id:
            return self.spec.run_id
        timestamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        short_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
        safe_case = "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c in ("-", "_") else "_" for c in self.spec.case_name)
        return f"{safe_case}_{timestamp}_{short_id}"

    def _build_paths(self) -> RunPaths:
        """Construct standard canonical paths inside the run directory."""
        return RunPaths(
            run_dir=self.run_dir,
            input_gds=self.run_dir / "input.gds",
            before_lyrdb=self.run_dir / "before.lyrdb",
            candidate_script=self.run_dir / "candidate_fix.py",
            candidate_stdout=self.run_dir / "candidate_stdout.log",
            candidate_stderr=self.run_dir / "candidate_stderr.log",
            patched_gds=self.run_dir / "patched.gds",
            after_lyrdb=self.run_dir / "after.lyrdb",
            layout_diff_json=self.run_dir / "layout_diff.json",
            results_json=self.run_dir / "results.json",
            report_md=self.run_dir / "report.md",
            run_manifest_json=self.run_dir / "run_manifest.json",
        )

    @staticmethod
    def compute_sha256(file_path: Path) -> str:
        """Compute the SHA-256 hexadecimal hash of a file."""
        sha = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            while chunk := f.read(65536):
                sha.update(chunk)
        return sha.hexdigest()

    def _get_git_commit(self) -> str:
        """Retrieve current git HEAD commit SHA if inside a repository."""
        try:
            res = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=False,
            )
            if res.returncode == 0:
                return res.stdout.strip()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return "unknown"

    def setup_run(self) -> RunPaths:
        """Create the run directory, snapshot immutable inputs, and write initial manifest."""
        self.run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        # Snapshot immutable input GDS
        shutil.copy2(self.spec.input_gds, self.paths.input_gds)

        deck_snapshot = self.run_dir / ("deck" + self.spec.drc_script.suffix)
        shutil.copy2(self.spec.drc_script, deck_snapshot)

        input_gds_hash = self.compute_sha256(self.paths.input_gds)
        drc_script_hash = self.compute_sha256(self.spec.drc_script)

        model_config = None
        if self.spec.candidate_mode == 'agent':
            script = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'harness/scripts/model-config.mjs'
            model_config = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['node', str(script)], text=True, timeout=10))

        manifest_data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "run_id": self.run_id,
            "case_name": self.spec.case_name,
            "created_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            "environment": {
                "python_version": sys.version,
                "klayout_version": db.__version__,
                "node_version": self._command_version(["node", "--version"]),
                "checker_cli_version": self._command_version(["klayout", "-b", "-v"]),
                "harness_packages": self._harness_versions(),
                "model_requested": model_config['model'] if model_config else None,
                "model_config": model_config,
                "git_commit": self._get_git_commit(),
            },
            "spec": {
                "original_input_gds": str(self.spec.input_gds.resolve()),
                "drc_script": str(self.spec.drc_script.resolve()),
                "profile_name": self.spec.profile_name,
                "candidate_mode": self.spec.candidate_mode,
                "top_cell": self.spec.top_cell,
                "edit_policy": self.spec.edit_policy,
            },
            "schema_version": 2,
            "deck_snapshot": str(deck_snapshot),
            "source_hashes": self._source_hashes(),
            "limits": {"wall_seconds": 120, "cpu_seconds": 120, "memory_bytes": 2147483648, "processes": 64, "output_bytes": 67108864, "log_bytes": 1048576},
            "hashes": {
                "input_gds_sha256": input_gds_hash,
                "drc_script_sha256": drc_script_hash,
            },
        }

        manifest_file = self.run_dir / "run_manifest.json"
        manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps(manifest_data, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        return self.paths

    def update_manifest(self, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update the existing run_manifest.json with new metadata."""
        manifest_file = self.run_dir / "run_manifest.json"
        if manifest_file.exists():
            data = json.loads(manifest_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        else:
            data = {}
        data.update(updates)
        manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    @staticmethod
    def _command_version(command):
        try:
            return subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            return None

    def _source_hashes(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        paths = list((root / "src").rglob("*.py"))
        for directory, pattern in (("harness/lib", "*.js"), ("harness/src", "*.ts"), ("harness/scripts", "*.mjs"),
                                   ("harness/profile", "*"), ("knowledge", "*.md")):
            paths.extend(p for p in (root / directory).rglob(pattern) if p.is_file())
        paths.extend(root / p for p in ("pyproject.toml", "uv.lock", "harness/package.json", "harness/tsconfig.json") if (root/p).exists())
        return {str(p.relative_to(root)): self.compute_sha256(p) for p in sorted(paths)}

    @staticmethod
    def _harness_versions():
        modules = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/"harness/node_modules/@deepseek-ai"
        versions = {}
        if modules.exists():
            for package in sorted(modules.iterdir()):
                path = package/"package.json"
                if path.is_file():
                    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
                    versions[data["name"]] = data.get("version")
        return versions
